We're looking for a motivated and ambitious engineer looking to build a strong foundation in geotechnical design. We also value:
An honours Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Geotechnical, or Structural Engineering (or equivalent). A post-graduate qualification in Geotechnical Engineering or Soil Mechanics is an advantage.
Over 3 years of post-graduate experience in geotechnical design and/or construction.
Strong technical understanding of the design of deep excavations, deep and shallow foundations, earthworks, slope stability, and soft ground solutions.
Good planning, organisational, and time management skills, with the ability to maintain personal effectiveness across several projects and communicate confidently in both technical and non-technical settings.
Experience in planning, managing, supervising, and interpreting ground investigation contracts, and/or experience in numerical analysis and GIS.
A commitment to continuous professional development, ideally working towards Chartered status, with the flexibility to travel and work on-site (a full driver’s licence is a strong advantage).
Why Arup?
At Arup, we believe in rewarding our members for their contributions to our shared success. As a trust-owned company, we have the freedom to pursue meaningful work that aligns with our purpose and values. We also offer a unique profit share program, allowing our members to share in the results of our collective efforts.

Global Opportunities: Collaborate with colleagues worldwide and explore potential short-term or long-term assignments at other Arup offices and project locations.

Equality, Diversity and Inclusion: We strive to embed inclusion in our way of working, our interactions with one another and the projects we deliver. We are committed to creating an inclusive working environment for talented people of any background, based on merit, fairness and respect.
At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective where individuality is encouraged. Our strength comes from how we respect, share, and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas. You'll have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, and to the clients and communities we serve.
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of the world around us. We actively promote a culture of inclusion where everyone feels welcome, respected, and valued.
We welcome applications from talented individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, disability, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. Proven experience selling luxury watches
Strong knowledge of premium and Swiss watch brands
Experience guiding customers through high-value or considered purchases
Motivation and ambition to achieve and exceed sales targets
Confidence delivering product presentations, seminars or guest events
A flexible, team-focused attitude and the ability to adapt to life at sea

Competitive salary, plus up to 6% commission – all take home pay
Included accommodation and meals provided onboard
No household bills while you are working at sea

Contracts of up to 6 months onboard, usually followed by 1 to 2 months at home between contracts

Bring your expertise, your confidence and your passion for watches, and start your next adventure with Harding+.

jobs.title: Graduate Programme, Accountancy - Cork (Sept 2027)
jobs.desc:
Job Description
Why Start Your Career at S&W?
Starting your career is about more than just a job. It's about the people you learn from, the relationships you build and the experiences that shape you. Whether that's passing an exam, achieving a personal milestone or celebrating success with your colleagues, you'll be part of a team that's invested in your growth, celebrates your achievements and supports you to be yourself.
At S&W, you'll be given meaningful responsibility from the start, alongside the support and guidance needed to help you succeed. You'll learn from experienced colleagues, develop valuable professional skills and build confidence as your career progresses.
As a growing accountancy and advisory firms, we offer a balance of opportunity and support. You'll learn from people at every level of the business, gain exposure to a variety of clients, industries and experiences, and develop the skills, knowledge and confidence needed to build a successful career.
The Accountancy Team at S&W
Our Business Outsourcing Services team helps businesses manage their finances, meet their reporting requirements and improve the effectiveness of their finance functions. Working with clients of different sizes, sectors and stages of growth, you'll gain first-hand experience of how businesses operate while helping them navigate day-to-day challenges and achieve their ambitions.
What sets S&W apart is the breadth of experience you'll gain from the start. You'll work closely with a diverse range of businesses, gaining exposure to accounting, technology and advisory projects that go beyond traditional compliance work. This breadth of experience, combined with structured training and support, will help you build a strong foundation for a successful career in accountancy and business advisory.
What Will You Be Doing?
As part of our Business Outsourcing Services team, you'll work closely with clients and their finance teams, supporting them with everything from statutory accounts and management reporting to VAT, bookkeeping and cloud accounting solutions. By combining technical expertise with practical advice, you'll help businesses operate more effectively and make better-informed decisions.
Alongside your work, you'll study towards the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) or Chartered Accountants Ireland (CAI) qualification, combining professional training with hands-on experience across a diverse range of clients and industries. This blend of technical learning and practical responsibility will help you develop a deep understanding of accounting, finance and business, providing a strong foundation for a successful career in accountancy and advisory services.
Your work will include:
Working with a diverse range of clients, supporting the delivery of statutory accounts, management accounts, bookkeeping, VAT returns and cloud accounting solutions.
Building an understanding of our clients, their businesses and the challenges and opportunities they face.
Preparing financial information and contributing to the delivery of high-quality client service.
Developing expertise in cloud accounting platforms and digital finance technologies.
Supporting clients with accounting queries, providing practical advice and helping to identify effective solutions.
Using technology and automation to help clients improve efficiency and enhance their finance processes.
Supporting software implementation, system optimisation and finance transformation projects.
Managing priorities across a portfolio of clients while developing strong organisational, commercial and relationship-building skills.
To Be Successful in This Role
You'll be someone who:
Is curious, eager to learn and open to new challenges
Enjoys working with others and building positive relationships
Has a keen eye for detail and enjoys solving problems
Is proactive and looks for ways to make a positive contribution
Takes ownership of their development and is motivated to achieve their goals
You'll also need to:
Be committed to working towards the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) or Chartered Accountants Ireland (CAI) qualification
Have some accountancy experience, as part of your education or work experience
Have obtained or be predicted a minimum 2:2 degree, in any discipline
Minimum 400 Leaving Certificate points (or equivalent)
Leaving Certificate O2 or H5 in Maths and English (or equivalent)
Your Learning & Development
We'll support you throughout your qualification journey with a leading UK training provider, dedicated study time and practical experience that complements your learning.
You'll join as part of a cohort and benefit from a strong support network that includes experienced colleagues, a buddy and our Learning & Development team. From your first day, you'll have people around you to guide you, answer questions and help you make the most of every opportunity.
As a Colleague at S&W, You'll Have Access to Benefits That Include
Fully funded training towards professional qualifications
Competitive salary
Private medical insurance
Life assurance
Pension contribution
Generous holiday package
Option to purchase additional holiday
Cycle to work scheme
Season ticket loan
Eye care support
Shared parental leave
Our Commitment to Inclusion
We are proud to value the differences that a diverse workforce brings, representative of society and our clients. At S&W we have a wide range of highly active employee resource groups and we’re delivering multiple diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives across the organisation. It is our commitment to provide a workspace where all colleagues, regardless of identity, background, or circumstance, feel respected as individuals and feel that they can achieve their full potential and work in a safe, supportive, and inclusive environment.
We are happy to make any reasonable adjustments to accommodate for your needs throughout the application process. Please let your Recruiter know.
IMPORTANT NOTES FOR COMPLETING YOUR APPLICATION
When you click on the
'I'm interested'
button, you'll be taken to your profile page. We're currently updating it, but in the meantime:
We can only accept one application to any of our programmes in a recruitment season. If you're unsuccessful, you'll need to wait until the following recruitment season to reapply.
Under the
Resume (CV)
section, uploading a document is mandatory; however, it will not be formally reviewed.

jobs.title: Graduate Electrical Engineer APM
jobs.desc:
Application Closing Date: 30th October 2026 - Please note we reserve the right to close roles sooner, so Early Application is encouraged.
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.
We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.
Role description:
Our two-year Graduate GROW Programme supports your transition from student to professional, sitting along client work and real projects from day one. Each graduate’s journey is unique, shaped by their chosen specialism and the variety of projects they contribute to. You will build your technical expertise by contributing to meaningful client engagements and project work, whilst business acumen and professional skills will be developed through centrally delivered graduate cohort training. Although there are no formal rotations, graduates are encouraged and supported by their managers to proactively seek opportunities, to broaden their experience and support their development.
As an engineer joining GROW, you will be given the opportunity to specialise within your chosen discipline of engineering and we ensure you obtain the appropriate experiences that you need to become a technical expert. Being an Engineer at Arcadis is about applying a human filter to all your technical expertise and training, and making an impact through innovation and creativity. During this two-year programme you will develop core engineering and consulting techniques that can be applied while working with our clients in the UK&I and potentially even some of our international clients around the globe.
Role accountabilities:
Joining a multidisciplinary team, you will support our clients with their project needs covering aspects such as architectural, process, HVAC, mechanical, electrical, commissioning, validation, and construction management services, across the industrial and pharmaceutical sectors. The design work will include electrical power, instrumentation, and building services across a range of pharmaceutical and industrial projects. You will be involved in the design and development of schematic diagrams and protection schemes for site electrical power distribution equipment and systems as well as creating semi-conductor tool install design packages, maintaining utility services matrix and/or databases and carry out design calculations for cable-sizing, short circuit calculations, lighting calculations, power balance studying, and arc flash for all electrical systems.
Accepted degrees: Level 7 Electrical Engineering and above
Qualifications & Experience:
You will be graduating in 2027 or have recently graduated in 2025 or 2026, with at least a 2:2 in a relevant master's or bachelor's degree
You will demonstrate typical Arcadian skills including Resilience, Creativity, Analytical Thinking and being a Team Player
You will have excellent communication skills and the ability to use your technical knowledge to influence and consult stakeholders.
Willing to travel and stay away from home when required (where possible we embrace virtual working)
Why Arcadis?
We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.
You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.
Together, we can create a lasting legacy.
Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.
Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging
We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day which is why we take equality and inclusion seriously and hold ourselves to account for our actions. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We believe that by working together diverse people with different experiences develop the most innovative ideas. Equality, diversity and inclusion is at the heart of how we improve quality of life and we work closely with our people across six ED&I Workstreams: Age, Disability, Faith, Gender, LGBT+ and Race. A diverse and skilled workforce is essential to our success.

jobs.title: Drone Pilot
jobs.desc:
Drone Pilot
Drone as a Service — United Kingdom
Location: Cork
Reports to:
Operations Director
Employment type:
Full-time
About the Role
We are looking for an enthusiastic Drone Remote Pilot to join our growing Drone as a Service (DaaS) team. You will operate uncrewed aircraft on behalf of clients across a wide range of sectors — including construction, energy and utilities, telecoms, infrastructure, agriculture, real estate, surveying and insurance — capturing high-quality aerial data for surveys, inspections, mapping and bespoke projects.
This is an entry-level position ideal for someone who is passionate about drones and aerial technology, eager to learn, and ready to build a long-term career in the commercial UAS industry. Full training will be provided, including support to obtain your CAA qualifications if you do not already hold them.
Key Responsibilities
Plan and conduct safe drone operations in accordance with UK CAA regulations and our Operations Manual.
Carry out aerial surveys, photogrammetric mapping, topographic and volumetric surveys, and visual or thermal inspections across multiple industries.
Complete pre-flight checks, site risk assessments, airspace checks and weather assessments before every flight.
Operate a range of UAS platforms and payloads (RGB, thermal, multispectral, LiDAR — exposure provided as you progress).
Capture, download and hand over raw data to the data processing team, ensuring quality, completeness and correct file management.
Liaise professionally with clients on site, representing the company and providing a smooth, well-organised service.
Maintain drones, batteries and ancillary equipment in good working order, and report any issues promptly.
Keep accurate flight logs, incident reports and post-flight records.
Travel to client sites across the UK, with occasional overnight stays where required.
Continuously develop your knowledge of regulations, equipment and industry applications.
Essential Requirements
A full, valid UK driving licence
(you will be driving company or hire vehicles to sites regularly).
Right to work in the UK.
Strong interest in drones, aviation, geospatial technology or aerial imaging.
Good physical fitness — the role involves outdoor work, carrying equipment and working in varied weather conditions.
Excellent attention to detail and a strong safety-first mindset.
Confident communicator, comfortable working directly with clients on site.
Tech-savvy: comfortable with smartphones, tablets, flight-planning apps and basic file management.
Willingness to travel across the UK, including occasional early starts, late finishes and overnight stays.
Eligible to register with the CAA (Operator ID / Flyer ID).
Desirable (Not Mandatory)
A current CAA drone qualification
— A2 Certificate of Competency (A2 CofC) or General Visual Line of Sight Certificate (GVC). If you don’t have one, we will sponsor and support you through it.
Recreational or hobbyist drone flying experience.
Background or interest in surveying, construction, GIS, photogrammetry, photography/videography or a related technical field.
Familiarity with software such as DJI Pilot, DroneDeploy, Pix4D, AutoCAD, QGIS or similar.
Basic understanding of UK airspace and CAA regulations (CAP 722 / UAS Implementing Regulation).
What We Offer
Structured training programme, including funded CAA qualifications where applicable.
Hands-on experience across a broad range of industries and use cases.
Clear career progression toward Senior Pilot, Chief Pilot or specialist data roles.
Use of industry-leading drone hardware and software.
PPE and equipment provided.
Competitive salary, pension and holiday allowance.
A friendly, fast-moving team that genuinely enjoys what it does.
How to Apply
Please send your CV and a short cover note explaining why you’d like to become a commercial drone pilot to [email address]. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

jobs.title: 2024 Graduate Process Engineer – Cork
jobs.desc:
Arcadis|DPS Group provides full EPCMV (Engineering, Procurement, Construction Management, and Validation) services for our clients, who are primarily in the pharmaceutical, chemical, and advanced technology industry sectors.
Working in our Process Department
Working in the Process Department youll be operating as part of a multi-disciplinary team, which handles our client needs in the following areas: architectural, process, HVAC, mechanical, electrical, commissioning, validation, and construction management services.
As a Graduate Process Engineer, you will be continuously developing your capability in process design  through contributing to active projects as well as participating in regular training (both technical and personal skills (such as presentation, communication, etc management skills) It is likely your work will involve working on projects in some of the following key areas: sterile manufacturing, fill finish, bulk API, oral solid dosage, chemical manufacturing, and microelectronics.
Day to day
Working as a Graduate Process Engineer your day to day role could involve the following activities
Bring designs from concept development right through detailed design to construction and commissioning.
Prepare and update PFDs and P&IDs as part of process design development.
Generate specifications for process equipment, analyse vendor bids and provide technical analyses to our clients.
Contribute to cGMP and HAZOP design reviews.
Continually learn about different technologies so as to deliver the best advice to our clients.
Use a range of software packages to develop process designs and analyse process problems.
Who Are We Looking For
Degree qualified in Chemical Engineering.
From 0-2 years experience.
Computer literate.
Excellent interpersonal, organisational, and communication skills.
Attention to detail.
Self-starter.
Ability to work as part of a team.
Flexibility required in terms of travelling to client facilities in Ireland and abroad.
Projects can entail extended periods working on client sites as well as in our design office.
Arcadis|DPS Group is a great company to work for and here are only some of the reasons why!
Join a Team
On joining Arcadis|DPS Group you will be part of a team from your first day, working closely with our existing graduate and senior engineers from your Department, you will start on a journey that will see you contribute to multiple international projects as part of a global team.
One DPS Team working together - YouTube
Accelerate Your Career
Have the opportunity to work in a core design team, working on multiple projects for major clients - plus have an opportunity to spend at least 6 months on client sites - executing projects in real-time, as part of your graduate development. Investment in your continuous professional development is a commitment from Arcadis|DPS Group. You will participate in our structured and accredited graduate development programme, which is delivered in your first two years, where the focus is to equip you with the tools to realise your ambition and make a greater impact in your role.
Achieve your Ambitions - YouTube
Make a Difference
As you will participate in projects for the world's leading Pharma, Biotech, and Advanced Technology companies, you can take pride in the fact that the facilities we create enable our clients to manufacture products that change lives.
Reasons to Join DPS (Why Join DPS) - YouTube
For further insight from our Graduates check out our YouTube Channel -

jobs.title: Service Desk Engineer
jobs.desc:
We are seeking an experienced and proactive
Service Desk Engineer
to join our global IT team. In this role, you will act as a key point of contact for desktop, laptop, mobile, and endpoint support across Windows and macOS environments. You will be responsible for managing service queues, executing user provisioning/deprovisioning, maintaining endpoint security tools, managing asset inventories, and driving IT automations to enhance end-user experience.
Key Responsibilities
Desktop & User Support:
Provide end-to-end hardware, software, network, and endpoint security support for Windows and Mac laptops/desktops.
Serve as a primary point of contact for end-user IT requests and technical issues.
Deliver support for mobile devices (Apple iOS, Android, and official corporate devices) and collaboration room systems.
Ticket & Queue Management (ITSM):
Manage and maintain the global Service Desk queue leveraging robust ITSM processes.
Triage, troubleshoot using Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), resolve, or escalate tickets per established procedures.
Keep end users informed on ticket status through phone, chat, email, or ticketing systems.
Identity & Access Management:
Perform user, group, and Distribution List (DL) provisioning and maintenance in Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and Exchange.
Endpoint & Systems Management:
Administer and deploy endpoints via modern management tools including Microsoft Intune, JAMF, and Microsoft 365.
Maintain endpoint security tools (e.g., Zscaler).
Manage hardware and software deployment, laptop imaging, IMAC (Installs, Moves, Adds, Changes), and file/print server provisioning.
Asset & Inventory Management:
Manage the lifecycle of IT assets, including laptop/desktop provisioning for new hires and hardware retrieval for departing employees (Onboarding / Offboarding).
Update and maintain accurate endpoint hardware inventory records using Jira Service Management (JSM) Asset Management and JSM Asset Discovery tools.
Process Improvement, Documentation & Reporting:
Recommend and implement self-service and automation solutions to streamline Service Desk operations.
Maintain SOPs and ensure technical documentation is updated in the repository following review.
Generate regular metrics reports on laptops serviced/provisioned, incidents resolved, and service requests handled.
Qualifications & Requirements
Experience:
3+ years of experience in an IT Support, Desktop Support, or Service Desk Engineer role within a global environment.
OS Support:
Deep hands-on experience troubleshooting both
Windows OS
and
macOS
.
Identity & Security:
Strong working knowledge of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Exchange, and cloud security tools (e.g., Zscaler).
MDM & Endpoint Management:
Proficient with Microsoft Intune, JAMF, and Office 365 administration.
ITSM & Tools:
Hands-on experience with Jira Service Management (JSM) or similar ticketing and asset management platforms.
Soft Skills:
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, strong customer-centric mindset, and a proactive problem-solving approach.

jobs.title: Material Handler - Cleanroom
jobs.desc:
Company Background:
ABEC is a leading supplier to the biopharmaceutical manufacturing industry. ABEC's unique value is based on combining long experience with the ability to engineer, design, manufacture, commission, qualify, and service the entire bioprocess to reduce overall cost, shorten time to market, and maximise productivity. ABEC's products include process and equipment engineering/consulting services, comprehensive site services, bioreactors and fermenters, filtration and chromatography systems, prep and hold systems, and cleaning/sterilisation systems.
Position Summary:
The Material Handler position manages inventory through database and maintain levels required on a daily basis to meet distribution demands.
This is an evening shift role - Monday to Friday 2pm - 10.30pm.
Responsibilities:
O Perform all necessary inventory transactions for materials & components being received into stock or issued out of stock for Production or Customer Service orders.
O Perform necessary data entry into ERP system to reflect movement of materials and components utilised for production of equipment or fulfilment of Service orders.
O Maintain accurate and complete counts of all inventory items in both the stockroom locations and as represented in the ERP system.
O Conduct periodic cycle counts and physical audits to reconcile inventory levels between stockroom and ERP system.
O Prepare, package and physically issue materials and components to Production in accordance with respective Shop Orders, Pick Lists or Bills-of-Material, verifying accuracy of Part No., quantity and Serial or Lot Number, as may apply.
O Monitor and report status of all materials stocked on a Min/Max basis to ensure adequate quantities are available at all times.
O Initiate orders for production supplies or consumable materials as requested.
O Assist the Production Department and the QC/Receiving Department as may be needed from time-to-time.
O Conduct various administrative functions as required in support of Quality Department activities.
O Assist in resolving discrepancies involving proper identification, quantity, location or inventory status of all materials and components utilised in the production function.
O Evaluate current procedures and propose process improvements that can increase accuracy, efficiency or productivity of activities in this or other departments.
O Assist with inventory analyses to identify and segregate slow-moving or obsolete items.
O Coordinate with Purchasing Department for items that can be returned to vendors or require some other disposition.
O Prepare materials and related documentation for transfer to other ABEC warehouse locations or process. incoming inventory transfers accordingly.
O Execute other tasks as assigned.
O Ability to travel when required.
O Operate forklifts and other equipment to move freight
Qualifications:
O Leaving Certificate minimum
O Previous experience in a manufacturing or cleanroom environment.
O Must be eligible to work in Ireland.
O Fluent in English.

Responsible for the calculation and reporting of hedge funds’ clients NAV’s.
Liaising with clients in relation to trade issues and/or corporate action issues.
Manage daily reconciliation of cash and positions - both listed, unlisted and OTC to Custodian's/Prime Brokers and Counterparty's.

jobs.title: Graduate Mechanical HVAC Engineer APM

Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.
We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.

Our two-year Graduate GROW Programme supports your transition from student to professional, sitting along client work and real projects from day one. Each graduate’s journey is unique, shaped by their chosen specialism and the variety of projects they contribute to. You will build your technical expertise by contributing to meaningful client engagements and project work, whilst business acumen and professional skills will be developed through centrally delivered graduate cohort training. During this two-year programme you will develop core engineering and consulting techniques that can be applied while working with our clients in the UK&I and potentially even some of our international clients around the globe.

As a HVAC Engineer you will support on key activities within HVAC/Building Services design. This will include supporting activities and projects across areas such as Energy Saving Review and Implementation, Sustainability systems, HVAC from basic ventilation systems to Grade A clean rooms, Chilled/Cooling water, Heating Hot Water/Heat Pumps, Steam and Condensate, Compressed Air and CHP.

Qualifications & Experience:
You will be graduating in 2027 or have recently graduated in 2025 or 2026, with at least a 2:2 in a relevant master's or bachelor's degree

You will have excellent communication skills and the ability to use your technical knowledge to influence and consult stakeholders.
Willing to travel and stay away from home when required (where possible we embrace virtual working)
Why Arcadis?
We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.
You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.
Together, we can create a lasting legacy.
Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.
Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging
We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day which is why we take equality and inclusion seriously and hold ourselves to account for our actions. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We believe that by working together diverse people with different experiences develop the most innovative ideas. Equality, diversity and inclusion is at the heart of how we improve quality of life and we work closely with our people across six ED&I Workstreams: Age, Disability, Faith, Gender, LGBT+ and Race. A diverse and skilled workforce is essential to our success.

As an Intern, you'll play a vital role in the success of Enterprise Mobility while gaining first-hand experience of what it takes to run a successful customer-focused business.
Working in one of our flagship retail branches, you'll spend your time interacting with customers, delivering exceptional service, and developing valuable sales skills in a fast-paced environment. This is real-world experience from day one. You'll take ownership of meaningful responsibilities, work alongside experienced colleagues and develop highly transferable skills that will help you stand out when entering the job market.

As an Intern, your experience at Enterprise Mobility will be as unique as you because you shape who we are as much as we shape your skills, path and potential. We pride ourselves on opening our doors to a variety of voices, giving way to an experience that’s both inclusive and that inspires diversity of thought.
This role is located in Cork
Responsibilities
The focus of your internship will be delivering outstanding customer service and developing your sales skills while gaining exposure to the wider operation of a successful business. Key areas of focus:
Customer Service & Relationship Building - Deliver exceptional customer experiences at every stage of the rental journey and build rapport with customers and confidently handle enquiries, reservations and concerns.
Commercial Awareness – Understand customer needs and recommend products and services that provide the right solutions for the customer.
Teamwork & Collaboration - Work collaboratively with colleagues to deliver exceptional customer service, support branch objectives and contribute to a positive team environment.
Communication - Support customers by clearly explaining rental agreements, vehicle features and additional products.

How a successful branch operates day to day.
How great customer service and sales directly impact business success.
Fleet management and logistical planning.
Business development and local marketing activity.

jobs.desc:

LUMI is a modern brasserie in the heart of Midleton, offering specialty coffee, creative brunch, seasonal dining, and a carefully curated wine selection. The team focuses on fresh, locally sourced ingredients and genuine hospitality, creating dishes that are both thoughtful and beautifully presented. Guests can enjoy breakfast, brunch, lunch, or evening meals in a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere designed for connection and comfort. The Head Chef at LUMI Midleton leads the kitchen team and oversees all aspects of food preparation and service in a full-time, on-site role based in County Cork, Ireland. Day-to-day responsibilities include designing and updating menus that reflect seasonal ingredients, supervising food production, and ensuring consistent quality and presentation across all services, from breakfast and brunch to dinner. The Head Chef manages kitchen operations, including ordering and stock control, maintaining food safety and hygiene standards, and coordinating with front-of-house leadership to deliver a seamless guest experience. This role also involves training and mentoring kitchen staff, managing rotas, controlling food costs, and contributing to the ongoing development of LUMI’s culinary identity.

Strong culinary skills, including experience with modern brasserie-style cuisine, seasonal menus, and high-quality brunch and dinner service.
Demonstrated experience in leading and managing kitchen teams, including training, performance management, and rota planning.
Proficiency in kitchen operations such as inventory management, supplier coordination, cost control, and workflow optimization.
In-depth knowledge of food safety, HACCP, and hygiene regulations, with a track record of maintaining rigorous standards.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment, balancing creativity with consistency and attention to detail.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills for working closely with front-of-house and management to enhance the guest experience.
Previous experience as a Head Chef or Senior Sous Chef in a quality-focused restaurant or similar setting.
Relevant culinary training or qualifications; professional certifications in food safety or kitchen management are an advantage.
Flexibility to work a variety of shifts, including mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays as required.

Inventory Management: Monitor and manage inventory levels across multiple production sites, ensuring a balance between stock availability and efficiency

Production Coordination: Engage with production teams to optimize processes, balance inventory targets, and ensure efficient use of resources across various factories
Cross-functional Collaboration: Act as a central point of contact between operations, sales, finance, and technical teams, explaining the logic behind decisions and ensuring alignment across functions
Problem Solving: Address and resolve issues that arise within the supply chain, adapting to variability in raw materials and changing customer demands
Quality Assurance: Ensure adherence to quality specifications, understanding that flexibility and adaptability are required due to the natural variability in livestock
Key Competencies
Numeracy and Data-Driven: Strong ability to work with numbers and data, using analytical skills to drive decision-making
Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to managing inventory, quality specifications, and operational processes
Communication: Ability to engage with a diverse range of personalities across multiple teams, maintaining clear and effective communication
Problem Solving: Agile in evaluating and resolving issues as they arise, often needing to find the balance between efficiency and quality
Adaptability: Comfortable working in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift rapidly, requiring flexibility and quick thinking
Other Role Information
Location: This is a site based role, learning the end to end process. There will be opportunities to travel to other Kepak sites and external locations throughout the programme
Training: Initial period of hands-on training in production areas, followed by a transition to more desk-based roles focused on data analysis and inventory management
Progression: The role is designed to develop future leaders within the company, with opportunities for progression into more senior positions after successful completion of the scheme
Our Graduate programme allows dynamic, motivated, hardworking, and passionate Graduates an opportunity start their career with one of Ireland & UKs leading meat businesses. The programme lasts 2 years.
You can expect:
To be fully immersed into our Culture from day 1, working alongside key industry experts and Kepak leaders
An opportunity to work in various departments across the business with a rotation plan tailored to your development, the rotations plan will vary by site
Gain an in depth understanding of our brands and products, and our relationships with customers and consumers
To learn key aspects of our business, whilst you develop your skills and knowledge
The opportunity to develop personally and professionally through exposure to key projects, tasks and development activities that challenge you, all supported by a detailed learner journey and training plan
A dedicated mentor and development program to support you both on the programme and into a role that best fits your skills
Start date:
September 6th 2027
Starting Salary
- €33,500 with an up to €2,000 increase at the start of Year 2 to €35,000
Read more about our programme and hear from some of our Graduates
:
https://www.kepak.com/careers/graduates/
Requirements
Who are we looking for?
We are looking for hardworking and ambitious Graduates, who want to learn and grow in a challenging and fast paced environment, by performing real roles as part of your rotations.
You must be mobile and willing to travel throughout the programme to undertake development activities at any of our sites in the UK and Ireland.
We will consider undergraduates from all disciplines and backgrounds.
Knowledge, Skills, And Experience
Educational Background: Open to all degree disciplines; however, a strong numeracy skill set is essential
Skills: Proficiency in data analysis tools and familiarity with inventory management systems is advantageous
Industry Knowledge: A basic understanding of the meat processing industry and product specifications is beneficial
Experience: Previous experience in a similar fast-paced, data-driven environment is a plus, but not required
Personal Attributes
Resilience: Comfortable working in a challenging environment, including exposure to abattoirs and carcass locations
Team Player: Willingness to work collaboratively across different teams and functions, sharing the load and supporting colleagues
Versatility: Capable of stepping into various roles within the supply chain, rather than specializing too narrowly in one area
Precision and Focus: A driven individual who thrives in a repetitive, detail-oriented environment
We will be looking for alignment with our Core Values:
Responsibility
- Ability to work on your own initiative and take accountability for your actions
Ambition
- You will have the willingness and confidence to challenge yourself to be the best you can be and be driven to succeed
Passion for Food
- this is at the heart of everything we do, you must be passionate about every aspect of our industry
Teamwork
- ability to build positive relationships quickly with people from all cultures and career stages is pivotal

Employee Discount Scheme
Service-Related Annual Leave
Discounted Health Insurance
Educational Assistance/ L&D
Discounted Meat Products
Cycle to work scheme
Employee assistance programme

jobs.desc:
Renewable Energy Analyst (Graduate)
Location:
Cork (hybrid)
Salary:
€45,000 - €55,000, depending on experience
Type:
Full-time, permanent
About us
We are a clean energy company that develops, builds, owns and operates renewable projects across the island of Ireland, with a portfolio spanning onshore wind, solar and battery energy storage (BESS). From our Cork office, our team supports projects across Munster and the wider island, in one of Europe's most exciting renewable energy markets. We are looking for a graduate analyst to help power that growth.
What you will do
You will work at the analytical heart of the business, supporting decisions across development, finance and operations. Expect variety, real responsibility and plenty of learning. Your work will include:
Building and maintaining models for project economics, energy production and market analysis
Conducting research on markets, policy, technologies and competitors to support strategic decisions
Supporting due diligence on new projects and acquisitions, working with data from every corner of the business
Analysing performance data from our operating fleet and reporting on trends and improvements
Preparing clear reports, dashboards and presentations for project teams and senior leadership
Supporting the development team with data for grid applications, planning and site selection
Improving the spreadsheets, tools and datasets the whole company relies on
What we are looking for
A degree (2.1 or above) in finance, economics, engineering, environmental science, data analytics or a related field
A genuine interest in renewable energy and the clean energy transition
Strong analytical skills and real comfort in Excel; experience with Python, SQL or data visualisation tools is an advantage
Attention to detail and the discipline to get the numbers right
Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to turn analysis into insight
Initiative and curiosity: you take ownership, ask good questions and learn quickly
The right to work in Ireland
Internship or project experience in energy, finance or data analysis is an advantage but not essential. We hire for aptitude and attitude, and we invest in developing our people.
What we offer
€45,000 - €55,000 starting salary, depending on experience
Hybrid working from our Cork office
A structured development path with mentorship from experienced analysts and managers
Exposure to development, finance and operations across three technologies
Pension contributions, generous annual leave and wellbeing support
Support for professional development and further study
The chance to grow with a company building and operating real clean energy assets

Apply with your CV and a short note on why this role interests you. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

Job Description
About Innovative Medicine
Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. The role contributes to developing and delivering the medicines of tomorrow while championing patients every step of the way.
About Transcend
Transcend is a global business transformation program modernizing foundational transactional processes and harmonizing them into one clean ERP. The program standardizes processes and establishes a fit-for-purpose digital backbone that enables operational agility, scalability, risk reduction, and long-term sustainability.
Role Purpose
The Deploy Experienced Analyst - Production Logistics provides advanced functional execution and subject-matter expertise to support deployment of production logistics capabilities within the Transcend SAP S/4HANA program. The role independently drives complex activities across solution confirmation, business process validation, testing, data readiness, cutover, deployment, and hypercare. The role preserves critical Production Logistics and MAKE integration knowledge across manufacturing sites and helps ensure alignment to the global template, regulated operations, and SAP Clean Core principles.
Major Duties & Responsibilities
Production Logistics Functional Expertise
Provide hands-on expertise across production staging, material replenishment, material issue and return, kitting, inventory movements, and warehouse-to-production integration.
Support end-to-end process alignment across Production Logistics, MAKE, SAP S/4HANA, EWM, MES, labeling, and related site systems.
Translate site requirements and operational scenarios into clear business requirements, process decisions, test conditions, and deployment actions.
Support production logistics master and transactional data readiness, validation, reconciliation, and governance.

Testing, Cutover & Deployment
Prepare and execute Functional Testing, SIT, Business Simulation Testing, UAT, regression, and end-to-end scenarios for production logistics and MAKE integration.
Develop and maintain test scenarios, scripts, expected results, evidence, and process-validation documentation.
Lead defect triage, business impact assessment, root-cause collaboration, retesting, and closure for production logistics issues.
Support mock migrations, cutover planning, inventory reconciliation, deployment readiness, go-live execution, and hypercare stabilization.
Capture lessons learned and contribute to continuous improvement of the global template and deployment approach.
Stakeholder Partnership
Collaborate with Deployment Leads, Business Process Owners, Product Owners, site SMEs, Manufacturing, Warehouse Operations, Quality, Data, JJT, and System Integrator teams.
Facilitate process decisions and drive timely closure of site-specific questions while protecting global-template standardization.

Required
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering, Operations Management, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
Minimum four (4) years of relevant professional experience in production logistics, manufacturing logistics, warehousing, supply chain operations, ERP deployment, or a related field.
Hands-on knowledge of production staging, replenishment, material issue/return, inventory movements, kitting, Labelling, RF Device Management and manufacturing integration.
Experience with SAP S/4HANA and/or SAP EWM processes supporting manufacturing and production logistics.
Experience executing testing, defect management, data readiness, cutover, deployment, or hypercare activities.
Ability to work independently, manage complex priorities, and collaborate across global and site-based teams.
Experience in a regulated or quality-controlled environment, with strong analytical, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
Preferred

Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, advanced therapy, life sciences, or regulated manufacturing.
Knowledge of warehouse/MES interfaces, labeling, cold-chain or controlled inventory, and master-data governance.

APICS, Lean, Six Sigma, FPX, PMP, or comparable certification.

jobs.title: Planner
jobs.desc:
Planner
Location: Cork
Duration: 12 months
Hours: 39
The core objective of the Replenishment Planner is to work in close collaboration with the Global PP&L Planning Teams to understand and consolidate direct materials’ supply demand, collaborate with key external suppliers and business partners to identify and manage supply risks and escalate as appropriate to (senior) stakeholders across the organization to mitigate short to medium term supply risks, ultimately approving longer term supply reliability.
Roles and Responsibilities
Responsible for procuring (new) raw materials and packaging supplies as well as management of intercompany purchases in adherence to defined procedures and regulations.
Assist the global PP&L Replenishment team in the development and execution of the direct materials replenishment and supplier integration strategy, business plans, cost reduction standards and metrics creation and tracking.
Lead supplier S&OP meetings for assigned suppliers and act as primary PP&L point of contact for any related supply escalations. Assist in the further development of supplier S&OP process and deployment across external suppliers.
Institute a disciplined strategic replenishment process with a focus on continuous improvement in total cost, quality and service. Ensure global and local supply agreements and contracts are updated accordingly by Source partners.
Review direct materials replenishment demand and respective capacity loads with supplier to identify potential manufacturing constraints. Partner with the supplier, Supplier Relationship Manager and site functions to resolve and mitigate potential supply challenges.
Provide strategic influence while building value-adding relationships with key suppliers and internal customer groups by applying advanced knowledge of purchasing principles, practices, tools and technology.
Support PP&L Planning teams in tactical recurring connects with supplier (e.g. for PO management) as needed for issue resolution. Facilitate the maintenance of accurate MRP / replenishment parameters for assigned suppliers.
Responsible for forecasted demand consolidation, understanding drivers for demand variability, raw materials inventory targets and quarterly submission of Joints Direct Materials spend projections.
Accountable for the timely submission and communication of supplier OTIF and PIT metrics internally as well as externally.
Identify opportunities to mitigate or reduce against risk in the supply chain and enhance supply capability. Implement Kanban, VMI, leverage from network CONFIDENTIAL use pursuant to Company Procedures opportunities, e.g. centralized inventory and purchasing, and other productive methods to achieve results.
Manage supplier relationships to achieve short and long-term business goals, in close collaboration with Source partners.
Work with Receiving, Accounts Payable and other departments as required to resolve issues, reconcile errors and correct the root cause of problems.
Review and improve supply chain processes assuring compliance with current regulatory standards and guidelines (Financial, EHS and Quality Assurance). Participate in audit preparation and support.
Responsible for communicating business related issues or opportunities to next management level.
Responsible for communicating business related issues or opportunities to next management level
Responsible for following all Company guidelines related to Health, Safety and Environmental practices as applicable.
For those who supervise or manage a staff, responsible for ensuring that subordinates follow all Company guidelines related to Health, Safety and Environmental practices and that all resources needed to do so are available and in good condition, if applicable
Responsible for ensuring personal and Company compliance with all Federal, State, local and Company regulations, policies, and procedures
Performs other duties assigned as needed
How to Succeed
A Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent, preferably Supply Chain related. IIPMM/APICS qualification is required.
Proficient in use of MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Visio) and experience with ERP systems, preferably JDE XE.
A minimum of 5 years’ experience in a senior Supply Chain role within a high volume regulated manufacturing environment, preferable a Procurement / Purchasing / Planning related function.
Minimum of 3 years procurement/sourcing experience preferred
Experience in Operations, Logistics, Planning, and Forecasting
Proficient in the use of MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). Prior experience with JDE XE or similar ERP system is highly desirable.
Proficient in Change Management concepts and tools.
Knowledge of and experience in applying Six Sigma and Lean methodologies.
Demonstrated ability to produce results according to established goals and standards.

This role offers a very competitive hourly rate. This contract will run for 12 months.

jobs.title: Nurse - Children's Services & Home Support, Ref D045
jobs.desc:
CoAction West Cork provides quality services to support children and adults with an intellectual disability, and children with autism. This is achieved by helping each service user reach their full potential, working in partnership with their families and carers, within the community.
Nurse
Children's Services and Home Support
Permanent Contract, 10 weekends per year (7.5 hours per week)
Waking Night, Sunday Premium, Saturday Allowances
Closing date: Friday 6th November 2026 @ 5 pm
Registered Nurse - Job Description
This job description indicates the main functions and responsibilities of the post and is subject to review and amendment in light of changing circumstances and may include other duties and responsibilities as may be determined from time to time by the Director of Services/CEO or designated Line Manager. You will be given as much notice of such changes as possible. It is CoAction’s policy to review job descriptions on a regular basis.
Reporting to:
The Children’s Services Coordinator /Nurse Co-ordinator
Overall Purpose of Position
The Registered Nurse will provide a nursing service to the designated geographical areas and to work as part of the West Cork Child Development Service. The nurse will act as keyworker and provide expertise to individuals who avail of WCCDS and CoAction services, taking primary responsibility for the medical care (assess, plan, implement and evaluate care) to the highest professional and ethical standards and best practice.
Initial Assignment:
To work with children with complex needs, providing home based nursing care in the community.
Main Responsibilities
Professional Responsibilities
The Registered Nurse Will:
Practice Nursing according to the Code of Professional Conduct as laid down by the Nursing Board (An Bord Altranais) and Professional Clinical Guidelines
Comply with national, regional and local Health Service Executive (HSE) guidelines, policies, protocols, legislation and CoAction guidelines and policies
Work within his/her scope of practice and take measures to develop and maintain the competence necessary for professional practice
Maintain a high standard of professional behaviour and be accountable for his or her practice
Be aware of ethical policies and procedures which pertain to his/her area of practice
Respect and maintain the privacy, dignity and confidentiality of the client / patient subject to the safety, health and welfare of the client/family not being put at risk.
Be on the An Board Altranais live register for general nursing.
Commute to the child’s home to administer appropriate professional nursing care.
Clinical Practice
The Registered Nurse Will:
Fulfil his/her statutory obligations within the legislation and HSE/CoAction policies as appropriate to the role.
Deliver nursing care to clients / patients according to best practice / evidence based framework
Manage a caseload as required
Promote the health, welfare and social wellbeing of all eligible patients / clients.
Link with the multi-disciplinary team in all aspects of service delivery including case conferences, clinical meetings, team meetings
Assess, plan, implement and evaluate individual person centred care programmes within an agreed framework and in accordance with policies procedures and guidelines and established best practice.
Develop and promote good interpersonal relationships with clients / patients, their family / social network
Participate in the development, promotion and implementation of infection control guidelines.
Endeavour to ensure that care is carried out in an empathetic and ethical manner and that the dignity and spiritual needs of the client / patient are respected
Promote and recognise the client / patient social and cultural dimensions of care and the need for links with their local community
Collaborate and work closely with the client / patient, his/her family, the multi-disciplinary team, external agencies and services to facilitate discharge planning, continuity of care and specific care requirements
Provide education and information to the client / patient, his/her family as required and be an advocate for the individual patient / client and for his / her family
Report and consult with senior nursing management on clinical issues as appropriate
Maintain appropriate and accurate written nursing records and reports regarding client / patient care in accordance with local / national / professional and confidentiality guidelines
Participate in innovation and change management in the approach to client / patient care delivery particularly in relation to new research findings, evidence based practice and advances in treatments
Participate in clinical audit and review
Participate in community needs assessment and on going community involvement
Promote a positive health concept with clients / patients and colleagues and contribute to health promotion and disease prevention initiatives as outlined by the Health Service Executive
Link with other services as required
Health Safety
The Registered Nurse Will:
Participate in the development of policies/procedures and guidelines to support compliance with current legal requirements where existing for the safe storage and administration of medicines and other clinical products.
Participate in the development of policies/procedures and guidelines with health safety risk and management personnel and participate in their development in conjunction with relevant staff and in compliance with statutory obligations
Observe, report and take appropriate action on any matter which may be detrimental to client / patient care or well being.
Be aware of the principles of risk management and be individually responsible for risk management/health and safety issues in their area of work
Comply with HSE/CoAction policies to minimise risk with particular reference to infection control, domiciliary visits and lone working
Education, Training Development
The Registered Nurse Will:
Keep abreast of the latest developments in nursing practice as far as possible.
Develop and use reflective practice techniques to inform and guide practice
Participate in the clinical / workplace induction of new nursing and support staff
Contribute to the identification of training needs pertinent to the clinical area
Develop teaching skills and participate in the planning and implementation of orientation, training and teaching programmes for nursing students and the nursing element of education for other health-care staff as appropriate
Identify and contribute to the continual enhancement of learning opportunities within a population health framework
Provide support guidance and advice to junior colleagues when required within the scope of practice.
Participate in regular performance / clinical reviews with his/ her line manager.
Administration
The Registered Nurse Will:
Ensure that records are safeguarded and managed as per WCCDS/ CoAction policy and in accordance with relevant legislation
Maintain records and submit activity data / furnish appropriate reports to the line manager
Contribute to policy development and formulation, performance monitoring, business planning and budgetary control
Maintain professional standards including patient and data confidentiality
Contribute to the development and implementation of information sharing protocols, audit systems, referral pathways, individual care plans and shared care arrangements
Contribute to on-going monitoring, audit and evaluation of the service as appropriate
Accurately record and report all complaints to appropriate personnel according to local service policy
Eligibility Criteria
Candidates Must:
Be registered in the relevant Division of the Register of Nurses kept by An Bord Altranais or be entitled to be so registered bearing in mind Directive 2006/100/EC for those nurses that have trained in one of the other 26 member states in the EU.
Health

Energy Infrastructure - Workplace Placement
See it differently
You see the world through a unique lens and that’s exactly what we need. We embrace how you see things differently – it’s essential for creating a sustainable future.
Arup is a global consultancy with advisory and technical expertise across more than 150 disciplines. We guide, plan and design the future of the built environment. Globally, each year we recruit hundreds of graduates and students who help us see things differently and solve the most complex challenges facing our clients, climate and communities.
The Opportunity
As an Energy Engineer work placement student at Arup, you will:
To be a part of a multi-disciplinary energy infrastructure team working to decarbonise our energy systems.
To deliver clean, safe, and resilient energy systems that conserve resources and restore habitats.
To support our clients to deliver on their energy transition ambitions.
To deliver renewable and transitional energy projects, particularly in the offshore wind, hydrogen, and decarbonisation sectors.
To contribute energy system expertise to your colleagues in other business areas (transport, science, industry and technology, property, etc.) and support the use of renewable technologies to support their clients.
Is this role right for you?
We Are Looking For Students Who Are Undertaking Studies In a Relevant Discipline (energy, Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Business, Economics Or Other). We Also Value
An ambition to support the growth of sustainable energy systems in Ireland.
Alongside your degree, we look for the following core attributes;
Changemakers: A passion for sustainable development and creating a better world is key.

Growth seekers: You have a growth mindset, always eager to learn and explore new ways of working.
Adaptable adventurers: You’re ready to take on any challenge that comes your way.

16 October 2026
Please note, in the event of high applicant volume, this role may be closed ahead of the advertised closing date. Early application is recommended
What we offer you
At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.
Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.
We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling permanent members to share in the results of our collective efforts.
We take an approach to flexible working that supports the diversity and wellbeing of our graduates.
Different people, shared values

We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas - this drives our excellence.
Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas.

jobs.title: 2027 3-Year Graduate Engineer Program
jobs.desc:
BioMarin is the world leader in delivering therapeutics that provide meaningful advances to patients who live with serious and life-threatening rare genetic diseases. We target diseases that lack effective therapies and affect relatively small numbers of patients, many of whom are children. These conditions are often inherited, difficult to diagnose, progressively debilitating and have few, if any, treatment options. BioMarin will continue to focus on advancing therapies that are the first or best of their kind.
BioMarin’s Technical Operations group is responsible for creating our drugs for use in clinical trials and for scaling production of those drugs for the commercial market. These engineers, technicians, scientists and support staff build and maintain BioMarin’s cutting-edge manufacturing processes and sites, provide quality assurance and quality control to ensure we meet regulatory standards, and procure the needed goods and services to support manufacturing and coordinating the worldwide movement of our drugs to patients. Come join our team and make a meaningful impact on patients’ lives.
BioMarin 2027 Graduate Programme - Engineering
Closing Date: 9th October 2026
Are you seeking a rewarding career in an end-to-end manufacturing facility in the biopharmaceutical industry? Make it happen at BioMarin in Cork
Our graduate programme is a three-year programme, designed to meet your development needs and career aspirations, incorporating your skills, interests and goals. BioMarin are looking to hire graduates to start employment with us in September 2027.
This programme is an opportunity to develop skills and gain experience across multiple departments, including:
Manufacturing
Engineering
Technical Development Sciences (TDS)
Quality
The BioMarin graduate programme provides a hands-on mentored learning environment to encourage development.
The 3 year scheme consists of 3 one year rotations across Manufacturing, Engineering and/or Technical Development Sciences and/or Quality.
Each placement will provide a variety of challenging, hands on, work experience. We are a high-performing, team-based organization, where colleagues are flexible, multi-skilled and empowered to make decisions. A high level of initiative, energy and motivation are key role requirements, as well as organizational skills. We are seeking self-driven, ambitious individuals eager to develop their careers in the Biopharmaceutical industry.
The Graduate programme will aim to
Provide graduates with an understanding of all aspects of an end-to-end biopharmaceutical manufacturing site
Develop the Graduates Engineering / Science knowledge
Provide the Graduate with the opportunities to apply that knowledge in the solution of a variety of problems
Develop technical and managerial Leadership skills,
Provide opportunities to develop Communication skills
Provide exposure to a regulated environment where high Quality and Patient focus along with Health and Safety are foremost.
Complete works that form part of their CPD programme to Chartered membership of IEI/IChemE as applicable.
Education And Experience
Currently undertaking a third level Degree / Masters in Engineering, graduating in 2026/2027.
Proficiency with standard office software applications, including MS Word, Adobe Acrobat, MS Access, MS Excel, MS Power Point expected.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Executive, EMEA
jobs.desc:
Description
Keeper is hiring a driven Enterprise Sales Executive to join our high producing EMEA B2B sales division. Qualified candidates must permanently reside in Ireland. This is a hybrid position for those living within a commutable distance to our Cork, Ireland office, or fully remote for those living outside a commutable distance.
Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations, globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and play a key role in our continued growth!
About Keeper
Keeper Security is a leading cybersecurity software company that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in more than 150 countries. Keeper delivers a powerful zero-trust and zero-knowledge solution built to meet the stringent requirements of public sector IT environments. Its flagship offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects users, devices and critical infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized in the Gartner® Magic QuadrantTM for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper combines robust compliance with unmatched visibility and control. With industry-leading certifications, Keeper provides the security assurance public sector organizations require. Learn why agencies trust Keeper to defend against today’s sophisticated adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.
About The Role
The Enterprise Sales Executive will drive new logo sales within an assigned geography, focusing on enterprise wide deployments of Keeper’s multi-product cyber security platform. This role requires a strategic thinker with 5+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS sales, exceptional communication skills, and the ability to build relationships with key decision-makers. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of success, an entrepreneurial spirit, and a deep understanding of the enterprise sales ecosystem.
Responsibilities
Create and implement a strategic sales plan to achieve revenue targets and expand market presence
Identify and pursue new business opportunities through cold calling, channel partner development, networking, lead generation campaigns and referrals
Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective customers, understanding their business needs and presenting tailored solutions
Build and create a constant pipeline of prospective customers
Manage the new business sales cycle from initial contact through to closing, ensuring accurate forecasting and reporting
Act as a subject matter expert on all Keeper products, staying knowledgeable and informed of changes, updates, and new products
Conduct high-level sales presentations and negotiations to secure large enterprise deals
Balance scheduling sales meetings with new clients on a weekly basis
Participate in cold call/role play activities and shadow cold calls with colleagues
Work collaboratively with the legal and sales ops teams to oversee the preparation proposals and execution of contracts, ensuring all terms are clearly understood and agreed upon
Work closely with the marketing, product, and customer success teams to ensure alignment and maximize customer satisfaction
Stay informed about industry trends, market conditions, and competitor activities to identify new opportunities and potential threats
Ability to travel to and from customer meetings (locally and nationally) & rent and/or operate a vehicle on behalf of the company
Requirements
5+ years of software sales experience
Experience selling identity access management solutions, including PAM (privileged access management)
An accomplished track record of selling software into IT organizations

jobs.desc:
About the role
Contract: Temporary
Fancy a festive in-store role? We’ve got all kinds of shifts and roles available.
Across the country, customers are counting on us to make the magic happen – and that’s why we need your help. Working in store, you’ll tackle a range of tasks, from serving customers and stocking shelves, to picking orders for home delivery. You’ll feel your impact every day, as you send customers home with a smile. Experience isn’t essential – all you need is the right attitude.
Because here, it all comes down to helping people: customers, colleagues, communities. If you’re warm and welcoming, you’ll fit right in with our caring, friendly bunch.
It all adds up to a role where you can do good, and feel good, while enjoying great flexibility. Let’s make every day a little better. Especially at Christmas.
#tescoxmas
You will be responsible for
You’ll help deliver Christmas for households across the nation.
You’ll provide support in store during the busy festive period.
You could be stocking shelves and making sure products are where they need to be.
Or, you could be serving customers and putting together orders for our Click and Collect service.
Whatever the task, you’ll take pride in making sure that customers get a brilliant experience.
You will need
Able to give great, natural customer service by proactively smiling, greeting, acknowledging and helping customers.
Works hard for customers, your team and your department.
You are able to prioritise to ensure anything you do is right for our customers.
Adaptable and resilient to meet the ever changing demands of our business.
You must be able to follow instructions either verbal or written.
You are reliable and a good timekeeper.
You must be smart and tidy at all times.
Whats in it for you?
We offer excellent benefits that help make Tesco a great place to work. These include but aren’t limited to:
Competitive Salary
Bonus Scheme*
Colleague Clubcard offering 10% discount across stores and online, with 15% discount weekends once a month (Friday to Sunday), and 20% off twice a year. There is also 20% off F&F clothing, all year long, these various discounts can be extended to a family member with a 2
nd
Clubcard available.
Life Assurance
Pension Plan*
Save As You Earn Scheme*
Paid Family Leave
Bike to Work
Long Service Awards
Commuter Scheme
Wellbeing Initiatives
*Entry requirements and rules of the scheme apply
About Us
Our vision at Tesco is to become every customer’s favourite way to shop, whether they are at home or out on the move.  Our core purpose is “Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day”.  Serving means more than a transactional relationship with our customers.  It means acting as a responsible and sustainable business for all stakeholders, for the communities we are part of, and for the planet. Through initiatives like the Tesco Community Fund, our association with Children’s Health Foundation, our partnership with FoodCloud and our Stronger Starts programme, we have supported over 21,000 community groups, raised over €7.5 million for medical equipment, and provided almost 15 million meals nationwide, to those living in food insecurity.
Tesco has operated in the Irish retail market since 1997, and with 170 stores nationwide, we employ over 13,000 people in cities and towns around Ireland, supporting almost 45,000 jobs directly and indirectly. We partner with over 500 Irish suppliers - of which almost three-quarters are small and medium enterprises - which in turn supports almost 13,000 farming families around Ireland. Tesco is the single largest buyer of Irish food and drink in the world, buying €1.6 Billion a year; more than any other single country in the European Union, more than even the USA which you perceive as a massive buyer of Irish food.
We work closely with suppliers across Ireland who are dedicated to making the best products for our customers and this is reflected in the numerous awards our products have won over the years including Blás Na hÉireann, World Steak Challenge and Great Taste Awards.
We are proud to have an inclusive culture at Tesco where everyone truly feels able to be themselves. It is embedded in our values: we treat people how they want to be treated.   At Tesco, we not only celebrate diversity, but recognise the value and opportunity it brings.  We always want our colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work and we are committed to helping them be at their best.
We know life looks a little different for each of us. That’s why at Tesco, we always welcome chats about flexible working. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life-changing moments like becoming a carer, nearing retirement, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we can support.
Tesco is committed to celebrating diversity and everyone is welcome at Tesco. We're committed to providing a fully inclusive recruitment process, allowing candidates the opportunity to thrive and inform us of any reasonable adjustments they may require. For further information on the accessibility support we can offer, please click http://roi.tesco-careers.com/accessibility/

Please let us know you need additional support by emailing
tescoireland.recruitment@tesco.ie
This will allow us to understand more about you and how we can best support you through the recruitment process.
