Rentokil Pest Control - Graduate Pest Control Technician
Join Our Team and Make a Difference!
Enjoy problem-solving and helping customers? Become a Graduate Pest Control Technician with Rentokil in Cork. Full training provided, no experience necessary. Apply now!
We are currently seeking a
Graduate Pest Control Technician
to join our dedicated team at the
Cork
branch, covering a
Cork
area. Successful individuals in this role have included graduates with a science-based, business management or social science degree. If you're looking for a company that prioritises colleague development, this could be the job for you!
Why Join Rentokil?
Competitive Salary Package: Start with a basic salary of €30,300 per annum, with an increase once fully trained
Expected OTE: €35,000 per annum, with bonus and commission schemes available
Benefits: Company vehicle, fuel card, mobile phone, uniform
Relocation Package: Moving from more than 2 hours away? We may offer up to €5,000 to help you settle in
Work-Life Balance: Full-time, permanent role, Monday to Friday (39 hr week), with potential for up to 48 hours in the future with an increased salary
Industry-Leading Training: Receive top-notch training to support our customers' pest control needs
Graduate Pest Control Technician Role:
You will start as a Pest Control Technician, with your initial 6-12 months dedicated to covering a specific geographical area. You'll provide invaluable support to customers by resolving their pest control issues while receiving comprehensive industry-recognised training. Key responsibilities include:
Inspecting customer premises for signs of pests and identifying potential risks
Swiftly tackling pest problems by cleaning and removing evidence of pest behaviour
Offering valuable advice to customers on the maintenance and hygiene of their premises
Completing accurate reports after every visit
Providing exceptional customer service and upholding a professional image at all times
During the next 12-36 months, you will have an exciting opportunity to choose your career path from one of the following roles:
Sales Surveyor
Field Biologist
Service Team Leader
Key Account Manager
Rentokil offers you the platform to follow your own career path while constantly learning on the job and developing your career.
Requirements

A minimum 2.2 degree in a science/BSc related subject including Social Science, or a BA in Business Management, Hospitality or Tourism
A full Irish driving licence
A desire to work hard and have fun while meeting and interacting with customers daily
Flexibility with working patterns to support business needs
You may be required to pass a Garda Vetting check depending on the role you have applied for
Benefits
Benefits:
A competitive salary package
Company Vehicle & fuel card
Long Service Awards
Uniforms and Equipment

4 weeks annual leave increasing to 5 weeks
Additional variable pay opportunity through the introduction of new business

Life Assurance
A Company Putting "People First"
Rentokil Initial (FTSE100) is one of the largest business services companies in the world, operating in over 90 countries and providing services that protect people and enhance lives. Rentokil is the world's leading commercial pest control services provider, Initial is the world's leading commercial hygiene services provider, and Ambius is the world's leading provider of plants and scenting.
As a business, we focus on the Right People, doing the Right Things, and in the Right Way. We invest a lot of time and money in training and developing all our colleagues to be the best they can be, and we are always looking for talented and driven people to join our Rentokil Initial Family.

jobs.desc:
Location/office policy:
Dublin/ Cork - 3 days per week in office
Start date
: September 2027

: €34,500
This role is being offered as a
23-month contract
Ready to start your career at AIB?
Join an award-winning graduate programme with AIB, recognised by gradireland as the ‘Most Popular Graduate Recruiter in Banking, Investment & Financial Services’ for six consecutive years and a winner of the Diversity Recruitment Award.
Work with some of Ireland's largest businesses, support major investment decisions and help shape the future of sustainable growth.
Our Capital Markets Graduate Programme offers the opportunity to develop commercial, analytical and relationship management skills while working alongside experienced professionals supporting corporate, institutional and private banking customers across Ireland and internationally.
At AIB, we know that starting your career is a big step. That's why we've created a graduate programme that gives you meaningful work, plenty of support and opportunities to develop both professionally and personally.
Over 23 months, you'll rotate across a variety of teams, gain exposure to exciting projects and develop the skills, experience and confidence needed to build a successful career.
No two days will be the same!
Why join our graduate programme?
As part of the programme, you'll gain exposure to different areas across Capital Markets, working with a wide range of teams, customers and colleagues.
You'll learn on the job, contribute to real business initiatives and work alongside experienced professionals who are invested in helping you succeed.
Along The Way, You'll Also Have Opportunities To
Pursue industry-recognised professional qualifications such as QFA, CFA, ACA, ACCA or CIMA, with financial support and study leave provided by AIB
Build your professional network
Attend development events
Connect with senior leaders across the organisation
Learn from graduates who have already completed the programme
Explore different career paths within AIB
This is more than a graduate programme. It's an opportunity to develop the expertise, network and experience needed to build a successful career in banking and finance.
What You’ll Do
Capital Markets serves AIB's large and medium-sized business customers as well as our private banking customers. We take a partnership approach, delivering customer-focused financing solutions and specialised products that help businesses grow, invest and achieve their ambitions.
As a Capital Markets Graduate, you'll contribute to financing solutions that help businesses expand, invest, create jobs and transition to a more sustainable future. You'll gain exposure to complex transactions and strategic client relationships from the very beginning of your career.
You will;
Support the assessment of lending and financing opportunities
Analyse financial information and market trends
Assist with customer relationship management and business development activities
Contribute to credit and risk assessment processes
Support transactions across a range of industries and sectors
Work with colleagues across lending, product, portfolio and customer teams
Rotational opportunities to help you discover your preferred business interest across our teams of:
Corporate Banking
Real Estate Finance
Climate & Infrastructure Capital
Syndicated & International Finance
Private Banking
Business Banking
Commercial Finance
Customer Solutions & Services
Portfolio Management Unit
What's in it for you?
As Part Of The Programme, You'll Benefit From
A comprehensive and interactive induction programme focused on credit, banking products and processes
Exposure to Capital Markets teams and introductions to senior leaders across the organisation
Ongoing classroom and online learning covering areas such as financial modelling, real estate valuation and presentation skills
On-the-job learning with some of Ireland's most experienced business lenders and relationship managers
Financial support and study leave for professional qualifications aligned to your career aspirations
A strong focus on wellbeing, inclusion and maintaining a healthy work-life balance
Every rotation will bring new opportunities to learn, challenge yourself and broaden your commercial and financial expertise.
Alongside Valuable Experience And Development Opportunities, You'll Enjoy
21 Days annual leave & 2 additional volunteer days
Additional AIB Bank Holidays – Good Friday & the day after St. Stephens Day
Hybrid working, 3 days in office & 2 working from home
Rotations across different teams
Dedicated graduate development programme
Professional qualifications supported by AIB
Access to senior leaders and mentoring
Internal networking events
Real project ownership from day one
Strong emphasis on wellbeing & work-life balance
Structured learning & development programme
Defined Contribution Pension Scheme
Vhi Healthcare scheme
Variable remuneration scheme
We are with you every step of the way
Starting your first professional role can feel daunting, but we'll support you every step of the way.
Every graduate is assigned a dedicated People Leader who will support your development, help you navigate challenges and encourage you to get the most from your experience.
You'll also become part of a vibrant graduate community, joining fellow Capital Markets graduates as well as graduates from previous intakes. Whether through learning, networking or social events, you'll build relationships that last well beyond the programme.
We also offer access to a wide range of support networks and initiatives, including our Employee Assistance Programme and Mentor Her programme.
Entry Requirements
Achieved or expected to achieve a minimum 2.1 Honours Degree (or equivalent for universities outside of Ireland)
Fully authorised to work in Ireland or hold a valid work permit for the full duration of the 23‑month contract (September 2027 – August 2029)
If you are not sure about your suitability based on any aspects of the role advertised, we encourage you to please contact our Future Talent Programmes team at Grads@aib.ie for a conversation.
AIB is an equal opportunities employer, and we pride ourselves on being the first bank in Ireland to receive the Investors in Diversity Gold Standard accreditation from the Irish Centre for Diversity. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees. Should you have a reasonable accommodation request please email the Talent Acquisition team at Grads@aib.ie
Apply today and start shaping your future with AIB.
Applications are expected to close on
26
th
October 2026
however, we encourage candidates to apply early as the programme may close sooner if demand is high.
Eligibility and Equal Opportunities
Applicants must be resident in the Republic of Ireland and be fully authorised to work, or hold a valid work permit, for the full duration of the programme. Any offer of employment will be conditional upon satisfactory evidence of the right to work in the Republic of Ireland.
AIB is an equal opportunities employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates and are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process.
Disclaimer
Unsolicited CV’s sent to AIB by Recruitment Agencies will not be accepted for this position. AIB operates a direct sourcing model and where agency assistance is required, the Talent Acquisition team will engage directly with our recruitment partners.

jobs.title: Customer Assistant - Midleton (25 - 30 hours)
jobs.desc:
About the role
We pride ourselves on offering customers the biggest range of products around. And that's not just food, but everything from clothes and kettles to financial services.
But did you know we offer the biggest job opportunities too? With stores across the UK and Ireland, and a variety of roles, we are always looking for people who are as passionate about helping customers as we are.
Our Every Little Helps approach doesn't just apply to our customers. It's at the very heart of everything we do at work - and it's what makes us different. We believe in treating each other with respect, and everyone having the opportunity to get on. That's what makes Tesco such a great place to work.
Should you be successful in your application, your offer will be subject to and conditional upon you providing your bank account details before your agreed start date.
You will be responsible for
Always put the customer first and consider them in everything you do.
Get to know your customers and serve them with pride.
Help to ensure products and services are available for customers at all times.
Handle all products with care to maintain quality and ensure they reach the customer in the best condition.
Keep the shop floor and back areas clean and tidy at all times.
Using the training you receive, follow department routines and processes.
Follow all company policies and adhere to Health and Safety routines.
Whilst you will have a core role, you may be asked to support your colleagues by helping in other departments.
You will need
Able to give great, natural customer service by proactively smiling, greeting, acknowledging and helping customers.
Works hard for customers, your team and your department.
You are able to prioritise to ensure anything you do is right for our customers.
Adaptable and resilient to meet the ever changing demands of our business.
You must be able to follow instructions either verbal or written.
You are reliable and a good timekeeper.
You must be smart and tidy at all times.
Whats in it for you?
We offer excellent benefits that help make Tesco a great place to work. These include but aren't limited to:
Competitive Salary
Bonus Scheme*
Our Virtual GP service provides free and confidential access to an online GP through video GP consultations, and online prescription service for colleagues. The service is also available to families of colleagues who live at the same address for a reduced cost.
24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and family members for in the moment emotional support along with free access to a range of wellbeing services supporting you under our new Wellbeing First approach of Body, Mind and Life.
Colleague Clubcard offering 10% discount across stores and online, with 15% discount weekends once a month (Friday to Sunday), and 20% off twice a year. There is also 20% off F&F clothing, all year long, these various discounts can be extended to a family member with a 2nd Clubcard available.*
Life Assurance
Pension Plan*
Save As You Earn Scheme*
Paid Family Leave
Bike to Work
Long Service Awards
Commuter Scheme
*Entry requirements and rules of the scheme apply
About Us
Our vision at Tesco is to become every customer's favourite way to shop, whether they are at home or out on the move. Our core purpose is "Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day". Serving means more than a transactional relationship with our customers. It means acting as a responsible and sustainable business for all stakeholders, for the communities we are part of, and for the planet. Through initiatives like the Tesco Community Fund, our association with Children's Health Foundation, our partnership with FoodCloud and our Stronger Starts programme, we have supported over 21,000 community groups, raised over €7.5 million for medical equipment, and provided almost 15 million meals nationwide, to those living in food insecurity.
Tesco has operated in the Irish retail market since 1997, and with 190+ stores nationwide, we employ over 13,000 people in cities and towns around Ireland, supporting almost 45,000 jobs directly and indirectly. We partner with over 500 Irish suppliers - of which almost three-quarters are small and medium enterprises - which in turn supports almost 13,000 farming families around Ireland. Tesco is the single largest buyer of Irish food and drink in the world, buying €1.6 Billion a year; more than any other single country in the European Union, more than even the USA which you perceive as a massive buyer of Irish food.
We work closely with suppliers across Ireland who are dedicated to making the best products for our customers and this is reflected in the numerous awards our products have won over the years including Blás Na hÉireann, World Steak Challenge and Great Taste Awards.
We are proud to have an inclusive culture at Tesco where everyone truly feels able to be themselves. It is embedded in our values: we treat people how they want to be treated. At Tesco, we not only celebrate diversity, but recognise the value and opportunity it brings. We always want our colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work and we are committed to helping them be at their best.
We know life looks a little different for each of us. That's why at Tesco, we always welcome chats about flexible working. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life-changing moments like becoming a carer, nearing retirement, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we can support.
Tesco is committed to celebrating diversity and everyone is welcome at Tesco. We're committed to providing a fully inclusive recruitment process, allowing candidates the opportunity to thrive and inform us of any reasonable adjustments they may require. For further information on the accessibility support we can offer, please click http://roi.tesco-careers.com/accessibility/
How can I let Tesco know I need additional support?
Please let us know you need additional support by emailing tescoireland.recruitment@tesco.ie
This will allow us to understand more about you and how we can best support you through the recruitment process.

Logistics is People Business – this guiding principle makes it clear that employees are the key factor to DACHSER's corporate success. Founded in 1930, our family-owned company is now one of the world's leading logistic providers. We provide intelligent logistic solutions worldwide. Together, we pursue the mission of creating the world's most intelligent combination and integration of logistic network competencies, thus optimizing our customers' logistics.
Are you looking for a job with prospects in a stable and future-oriented company? Then apply at DACHSER and drive the logistics of the future forward with us.
Purpose of role
Role: Transport Coordinator
Contract: Permanent Full time
Hours: 9am-6pm Monday to Friday
Location: Courtstown Industrial Estate Cork
An excellent opportunity has opened up at our Cork Depot based in Little Island for a Junior Transport Co-ordinator. This is an entry level role. The planner ensures that our fleet is operating in time and that our customers’ needs are met and exceeded. The Transport Coordinator will work closely with Driver group, Transit Terminal and our customer service team. A strong knowledge of local geography is key. The planner will also allocate collection requests as well as engaging in any ‘second run’ activity.
The role requires an energetic person comfortable with adopting a leadership role where needs be. You will work with a team of Cross Dock Forklift Operators and work cross functionally with multiple stakeholders and will be expected to train on and operate forklifts as needed. There is an expectation that the Planner will support the night shift during periods of annual leave as well as to develop a working knowledge of daytime roles too in order to have a depth of understanding as to how the business works.
Key Responsibilities
To help plan the efficient routing of daily deliveries in the Munster Area.
Must be available to work Monday – Friday, 9:00 am to 16:00 pm. Flexibility due to additional days/hours during peak periods is required.
Utilize the operating systems to plan daily driver routes, assuring all customer needs or requirements are met.
Communicate transportation delays to the team.
Work with service partners where needed optimising fleet dispatch.
Provides support to Branch Night Shift as needed.
Ensuring that the team follow all safety requirements and understand how to react in the event of an incident or accident.
Observing all security protocols. Gate close, shutters used and suspicious behaviour reported.
Skills & Experience:
3 to 5 years’ experience route planning in the Domestic Logistics or Transport Industry.
Knowledge of RSA/HSA regulations drivers hours, load security, ADR regulations advantageous.
Problem-solving skills, an ability to multi-task and the confidence to make decisions.
Ability to successfully manage within deadlines.
Strong transport planning skills and knowledge of Munster areas essential.
Good attention to detail skills a distinct advantage.
Good computer skills with experience using Microsoft Products (Outlook, Excel, Word)
Excellent communications skills, both verbal and written.
Ability to work independently, as well as in a team environment
Benefits That Support You
At DACHSER, we believe in taking care of our people — inside and outside of work. Here’s what you can enjoy as part of our team:
Free Car Parking — hassle-free parking every day, so your commute is stress-free.
Life Assurance — Death in Service benefit to provide peace of mind for you and your loved ones.
Employee Assistance Programme — confidential support to help you manage any personal challenges affecting your wellbeing and work.
Employee Discounts — from day one, access exclusive deals on holidays, fashion, supermarkets, gyms, insurance, and more.
Pension Plan — a flexible, tax-efficient pension scheme where you decide your contribution level, helping you plan.
Health Perks — free eye tests and money-off vouchers to keep you feeling your best.
Internal Referral Fees — know someone perfect for the team? Earn rewards by referring great talent.
Long Service Awards — we celebrate and reward your loyalty and commitment over time.
Join Our Inclusive Family
At DACHSER, everyone is welcome. Diversity and equal opportunities are at the heart of who we are. We value the unique qualities each person brings, believing that diverse teams drive innovation and success. Because for us, logistics is a people business — and we can’t wait to meet you.

Tyndall National Institute is an international leader in semiconductors, photonics and deep-tech research and innovation. As a leading collaborative European research institute, Tyndall is a key actor and hosting partner in the delivery of the ‘Chips for Europe Initiative’ (EU Chips Act).
Tyndall is Ireland’s leading research and innovation organisation and it is the national focal point for excellence in deep-tech research, development and graduate training at the convergence of nanotechnology, microelectronics, photonics, electronics and AI. Tyndall is recognised as an international research leader in semiconductor, chip and digital technologies, particularly as applied to the fields of Information & Communications, Health & Life Sciences, Agritech & Food Security, Energy and Climate Mitigation, emerging fields such as quantum, and novel computing paradigms.
The Institute’s key objective is to see frontier research activities having a significant impact on economic development and societal challenges in Ireland, Europe and beyond. Central to Tyndall’s mission is delivering economic impact through research excellence in partnership with industry and academia. With an annual turnover of more than €50m, the Institute has a community of over 600 researchers, engineers, support staff, postgraduate students, interns and industry researchers-in-residence.
With significant committed Irish government support, Tyndall will grow to be 1,000 people by 2030, with approximately 750 researchers, including 250 PhD students. A new 17,000 m2 research building is under development adjacent to the Cork headquarters and there are developing plans to expand Tyndall’s existing Dublin research labs and to establish other research sites within Ireland.
Tyndall’s expansion is also supported by recent national and EU funding wins for significant (M€10’s) additional research equipment across a range of areas such as semiconductor processing, microscopy, quantum technologies, heterogeneous integration, ultra-high speed optical communications and RF through THz characterisation.
Key to the success of Tyndall is its outreach programme with the community, bridging science to the public, engaging in science education, citizen science, engaged communities, policymakers amongst others. Hence, the successful candidate will co-ordinate, organise and participate in a wide range of activities locally, nationally and internationally, working together with Tyndall students and staff, Research Ireland staff based in Tyndall and external partners. The role will require engagement with a variety of stakeholders (researchers, science communicators, schools, general public, policy makers etc) using a variety of media.
Please note that this role is available to start immediately and that in line with statutory requirements for working with children and vulnerable persons, a vetting disclosure from the National Vetting Bureau will be required prior to appointment.

Ensure the use of Logic models to define and implement engagement programmes of strategic importance to Tyndall
Plan, develop and implement public engagement, engaged research, outreach programmes and activities that are informative, engaging, fun and, where relevant, curriculum focused

Form partnerships with other outreach providers and community, collaborating locally, nationally and at European level to leverage and assist with both new and existing programmes
Pursue funding opportunities and collaborations to sustain and develop activities and reach new audiences
Provide EPE induction as part of Tyndall’s on boarding to new hires as and when required
Manage, maintain and update the Tyndall EPE intranet pages and external EPE page on the Tyndall website
Assist, when applicable, with funded-centres progress reports, on-site reviews, annual reports and any other KPI reporting requirements
Keep informed of developments in EPE best practice and implement where appropriate

Carry out any additional duties as may reasonably be required within the general scope and level of the post

Typically, 3+ years experience in communicating science with the public
Significant experience in networking, building relationships and motivating others, with examples
Excellent communications skills
Excellent project management skills, including demonstrable experience in running events and alignment with employer’s strategies
Experience in applying for funding to run EPE and/or Citizen Science programmes
Demonstrated experience in working flexibly, creating independent initiatives, and as part of a team

jobs.desc:
Turn your knowledge of spirits into standout guest experiences, from tastings and cocktail conversations to premium liquor sales at sea.
We’re looking for
Liquor Sales Specialists
to join our onboard retail teams, working on cruise ships around the world.
This role is for someone who knows their way around premium spirits and enjoys sharing that knowledge with others. You might come from a retail liquor background, duty free, hospitality, bar work, mixology or brand ambassador experience. What matters is that you can talk confidently about different spirits, explain flavour profiles, recommend products and create a tasting experience that guests remember.
About Harding+
Harding+ is a leading cruise retail business, working closely with cruise line partners and brand partners to make every cruise better. Our onboard boutiques offer guests a carefully selected range across liquor, fragrance, beauty, fashion, jewellery, watches, confectionery and logo products.
We are proud to have been recognised as Cruise Retailer of the Year in 2022, 2023 and 2025, reflecting our focus on excellent service, strong brand partnerships and memorable guest experiences.
What You’ll Do
As a
Liquor Sales Specialist
, you’ll be the person who helps guests discover, understand and enjoy our premium liquor range. You’ll introduce products with confidence, explain the difference between spirits, talk through flavour notes and make recommendations that feel relevant to the guest, whether they are buying a gift, choosing something for an occasion or treating themselves.
You’ll support tastings, seminars, in-store events and promotional activity, using these moments to create interest, start conversations and convert sales. You’ll be comfortable holding the attention of a small group, answering questions and making the experience feel relaxed, enjoyable and informative.
This is a hands-on sales role. You’ll need to approach guests naturally, spot buying signals, suggest complementary products and keep momentum without making the interaction feel forced. You’ll also help maintain strong visual standards, accurate stock handling and compliance processes, while sharing your product knowledge with the wider team.
What You’ll Bring
We’re looking for someone with strong knowledge of spirits and experience using that knowledge in a customer-facing environment.
You’ll Bring
Experience in liquor retail, duty free, hospitality, mixology, bar work, brand ambassador work or premium retail
Strong knowledge of different spirits, such as whisky, rum, gin, vodka, tequila, cognac or liqueurs
Confidence discussing flavour profiles, serves, cocktail ideas, gifting options and brand stories
The ability to host or support tastings, demonstrations, seminars or promotional events
Motivation and ambition to achieve sales targets and maximise every sales opportunity
A positive, team-focused attitude and willingness to share knowledge
Fluency in English; additional languages would be an advantage
A good level of physical fitness, as the role involves being active throughout the day
What You’ll Get
Competitive salary with target-based commission
Included Accommodation and meals provided onboard
No household bills while you are working at sea
Support with necessary visas and seafaring documents
Dedicated in-house training across sales, product and brand knowledge
The opportunity to travel the world while earning
Contracts of up to 6 months onboard, usually followed by 1 to 2 months at home between contracts
On selected cruise lines, the opportunity to travel independently after your contract, with support for your return travel home afterwards

jobs.title: Android Applications Developer
jobs.desc:
Company Overview
At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
Department Overview
Department Description
Innovation is the oxygen of our company, and in 2023, we invested more than US$850 million in research and development (R&D). We’re now opening a new Research & Development Centre in Cork, Ireland focused on designing software for the company’s comprehensive land mobile radio (LMR) portfolio, with plans for expansion across other technologies in the future.
Motorola Solutions’ ecosystem of technologies is centred on safety and security, with LMR representing a foundational core. The company has deployed more than 13,000 LMR networks worldwide, trusted by governments and enterprises for highly secure communications designed to work in the most extreme conditions. Modernised with broadband and advanced data applications, LMR remains at the forefront of providing public safety agencies with the communications they rely on and need.
You’ll be part of our diverse and experienced global team, developing meaningful solutions that support thousands of public safety agencies and enterprises worldwide in solving complex safety and security challenges. Come join our team to work on real-world projects with a real-world impact.
Job Description
We are seeking an experienced Senior Android Applications Developer to design, build, and maintain mission-critical Android applications supporting public-safety communication, situational awareness, and operational data systems. These applications are used by emergency responders and must operate reliably in demanding field environments with intermittent connectivity, device integrations, and high availability requirements.
The successful candidate will collaborate with product management, UI/UX, backend platform teams, and device integration teams to deliver secure, resilient, and performance-optimized applications, while driving engineering excellence, architectural consistency, and technical mentorship across the organization.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain mission-critical Android applications using Kotlin-first development practices.
Implement resilient, offline-capable, and fault-tolerant mobile solutions capable of operating in low-connectivity or degraded network environments.
Build modern Android user interfaces using Jetpack Compose while ensuring usability in high-stress operational workflows.
Implement scalable, modular architectures (e.g., MVVM, Clean Architecture, modularization) supporting large multi-feature applications.
Integrate with backend systems, real-time messaging platforms, and device services using REST, streaming, and event-driven APIs.
Develop and maintain integrations with Bluetooth, radio communication interfaces, sensors, GPS/location, and background services.
Optimize applications for performance, battery efficiency, and reliability under continuous operational use.
Implement secure communication, authentication, and data-protection mechanisms aligned with enterprise and public-safety security requirements.
Contribute to automated testing, reliability validation, and release quality gates including unit, integration, and instrumentation testing.
Support CI/CD pipelines, release automation, and operational monitoring of deployed mobile applications.
Participate in technical design reviews, mentor engineers, and promote engineering best practices across teams.
Diagnose field issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement durable fixes for production deployments.
Basic Requirements
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong experience developing production Android applications using Kotlin and the Android SDK.
Experience designing high-reliability, enterprise, or mission-critical mobile applications.
Experience with modern Android UI development using Jetpack Compose.
Strong knowledge of Android architecture components (ViewModel, Navigation, Lifecycle, WorkManager).
Experience implementing offline-first data synchronization, caching, and conflict-handling strategies.
Experience working with Bluetooth, device integrations, background processing, or hardware-adjacent APIs.
Experience with networking frameworks such as Retrofit, OkHttp, or Ktor.
Strong debugging, performance optimization, and secure coding practices.
Experience working with Git-based development workflows.
Strong collaboration and communication skills within cross-functional engineering environments.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working on public safety, communications, defense, or highly regulated enterprise mobile platforms.
Experience integrating with radio communication systems, push-to-talk, messaging, or real-time communication frameworks.
Experience implementing secure mobile architectures including certificate-based authentication, encrypted storage, and hardened builds.
Experience with dependency injection frameworks (Hilt/Dagger).
Familiarity with modular Android architectures for large-scale applications.
Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical initiatives.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments supporting multi-team product releases.
Familiarity with Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) for sharing business logic across mobile or cross-platform applications.
Familiarity with Compose Multiplatform for building shared UI components across Android and other supported platforms.
Experience with Firebase, observability platforms, or operational telemetry tooling.
Travel Requirements
None
Relocation Provided
None
Position Type
Experienced
Referral Payment Plan
No
Company
Motorola Solutions Ireland Limited
EEO Statement
Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.
We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

Starting your career is about more than just a job. It's about the people you learn from, the relationships you build and the experiences that shape you. Our Business Outsourcing Services team helps businesses manage their finances, meet their reporting requirements and improve the effectiveness of their finance functions. As part of our Business Outsourcing Services team, you'll work closely with clients and their finance teams, supporting them with everything from statutory accounts and management reporting to VAT, bookkeeping and cloud accounting solutions. Alongside your work, you'll study towards the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) or Chartered Accountants Ireland (CAI) qualification, combining professional training with hands-on experience across a diverse range of clients and industries. Be committed to working towards the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) or Chartered Accountants Ireland (CAI) qualification

We'll support you throughout your qualification journey with a leading UK training provider, dedicated study time and practical experience that complements your learning.
You'll join as part of a cohort and benefit from a strong support network that includes experienced colleagues, a buddy and our Learning & Development team. From your first day, you'll have people around you to guide you, answer questions and help you make the most of every opportunity.

Fully funded training towards professional qualifications
Competitive salary

Life assurance
Pension contribution
Generous holiday package
Option to purchase additional holiday
Cycle to work scheme

Our Commitment to Inclusion
We are proud to value the differences that a diverse workforce brings, representative of society and our clients. Our vision at Tesco is to become every customer's favourite way to shop, whether they are at home or out on the move. We work closely with suppliers across Ireland who are dedicated to making the best products for our customers and this is reflected in the numerous awards our products have won over the years including Blás Na hÉireann, World Steak Challenge and Great Taste Awards.
We are proud to have an inclusive culture at Tesco where everyone truly feels able to be themselves. It is embedded in our values: we treat people how they want to be treated. Are you eager to advance your career at the cutting edge of global supply chain standards?! An exciting opportunity for a Supply Demand Planner has become available on the EMEIA Supply Demand Management team! This team sits in the wider Operations team, based at Apple’s European HQ in Cork, Ireland. The Supply Demand Management (SDM) team are responsible for end-to-end product planning for the EMEIA market, ensuring that all of our products are in the right place, at the right time, in order to ensure our customers can avail of our products when and where they need to. Our SDM team collaborate with many cross-functional teams including Logistics, Reseller Operations, Manufacturing and Finance.

Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure a balanced supply across the EMEIA region, driving efficiency and excellence. Strategise and execute inventory replenishment plans to maintain optimal stock levels and reduce obsolescence. Track and report KPIs and metrics to continuously assess and enhance supply chain performance. Build strong relationships with key stakeholders (Sales, Finance, Global Teams, Logistics, etc.) to ensure alignment and collaboration. The Opportunity
We are currently seeking a Work Placement Geotechnical Engineer to join our specialist Ground Engineering team in Cork, Dublin, or Limerick, Ireland. The team provides geotechnical input to a portfolio of exciting, varied and multidisciplinary projects across Ireland and internationally. Our work spans major infrastructure, energy, water, environmental and development projects, with a strong focus on understanding ground and groundwater conditions and managing ground-related risks
During your work placement at Arup, you will work alongside a team on tasks such as:
Geological, hydrogeological and geotechnical desk studies, site assessments and development of conceptual ground models.

Working closely with specialists from other disciplines to develop integrated and sustainable engineering solutions.

PSC Biotech is a leading Biotech Consultancy firm founded in 1996, headquartered in Pomona, California, USA, with Global operations in Ireland, India, Singapore, Australia and the US, serving 350 clients in more than 23 countries worldwide. A RF Power Electronics Engineer is required by CareerWise Recruitment to join our based Cork based MN medical device client. Working within a multi-disciplinary R&D team you have responsibility for new product and process development. Permanent role.
Role
* Design, develop, refine and evaluate electrical components, assemblies and subsystems for electrosurgery medical devices.
* Lead the design and implementation of high-energy electrical subsystems for patient-connected medical devices.
* Translate user, clinical and system-level needs into electrical requirements, specifications and system designs.
* Apply concurrent engineering, rapid prototyping and advanced testing methods to accelerate product development while meeting cost, quality and compliance requirements.
* Provide technical guidance, mentoring and training to team members on product commercialisation, design trade-offs, technology development and complex engineering challenges.

* Hands-on experience designing custom magnetics, including high-frequency isolation transformers.
* Strong understanding of RF engineering, electromagnetics, electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), measurement systems, sensing and control interfaces, particularly in high dv/dt and high common-mode noise environments.
* Proven ability to guide testing, troubleshooting, PCB and cable design, electrical stack-ups, statistical analysis, and manufacturing and test methods.

jobs.title: STA Design Engineer
jobs.desc:
We are looking for an experienced
Static Timing Analysis (STA) Engineer
to join a world-leading semiconductor company developing next-generation, high-performance, low-power SoCs. You'll play a key role in timing signoff, timing closure and methodology development, working closely with cross-functional engineering teams to deliver cutting-edge silicon.
As an STA Engineer, you will be responsible for performing static timing analysis, developing and validating timing constraints, and driving timing closure across complex ASICs and SoCs. Working with RTL, Synthesis and Physical Design teams, you'll help optimise performance, power and area while ensuring designs meet timing signoff requirements.
Responsibilities
Perform static timing analysis and timing closure for complex cores and full-chip SoCs.
Develop and improve STA methodologies, flows and timing signoff processes.
Drive timing accuracy while improving static and dynamic analysis turnaround times.
Ensure designs meet timing signoff criteria and project quality standards.
Develop automation for timing and power data collection, processing and analysis.
Support project planning by contributing to technical milestones and deliverables.
Deliver project objectives on schedule while providing production support when required.
Troubleshoot and resolve timing-related issues throughout the development lifecycle.
Requirements
Experience using STA tools such as PrimeTime, PrimeShield or Tempus for hierarchical timing analysis on large SoCs.
Hands-on experience with timing ECO tools including Tweaker, PrimeClosure, PTECO or Tempus ECO.
Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Tcl and/or Perl.
Solid understanding of the ASIC implementation flow from RTL through to GDS.
Knowledge of Design for Parametric Yield would be beneficial.
Experience with extraction and circuit simulation tools is advantageous.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a practical, results-focused approach.

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.desc:
Acuity Inc. (NYSE: AYI) is a market-leading industrial technology company. We use technology to solve problems in spaces, light and more things to come. Through our two business segments, Acuity Brands Lighting (ABL) and Acuity Intelligent Spaces (AIS), we design, manufacture, and bring to market products and services that make a valuable difference in people’s lives.
We achieve growth through the development of innovative new products and services, including lighting, lighting controls, building management solutions, and an audio, video and control platform. We focus on customer outcomes and drive growth and productivity to increase market share and deliver superior returns. We look to aggressively deploy capital to grow the business and to enter attractive new verticals.
Acuity Inc. is based in Atlanta, Georgia, with operations across North America, Europe and Asia. The Company is powered by approximately 13,000 dedicated and talented associates. Visit us at www.acuityinc.com.
Job Summary
The
Software Architect
for the Acuity Product Data Management (PDM) system is responsible for defining and maintaining the technical architecture, engineering standards, and technology roadmap for one of Acuity's most critical enterprise platforms. PDM manages product series, option groups, attributes, assets, pricing, validation, and ordering information consumed by commerce, quoting, ordering, manufacturing, and downstream enterprise systems.
This role combines deep technical leadership with hands-on architecture and coding, solution design, modernization planning, and engineering governance. The architect partners with Product Management, Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, DevOps, Security, Data, and business stakeholders to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable, and aligned to business objectives.
Key Tasks & Responsibilities (Essential Functions)
Enterprise System Design: Architect end-to-end distributed systems with a focus on scalability, high availability, fault tolerance, and loose coupling across complex enterprise platforms.
Cloud Architecture: Design and optimize multi-tier cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), apply cloud-native patterns, infrastructure-as-code (IaC), and cost-effective resource management.
API & Integration Strategy: Define standards for API design, lifecycle management, and service integration (REST, GraphQL, gRPC), ensuring robust contracts, backward compatibility, and developer ergonomics.
Multi-Language Fluency: Leverage deep hands-on expertise in core enterprise programming ecosystems, principally Python, C# (.NET), and Java, to guide language-appropriate architectural decisions and evaluate technical trade-offs.
Software Craftsmanship & Design Patterns: Champion clean architecture, domain-driven design (DDD), and classic design patterns to ensure codebases remain maintainable, testable, and modular over time.
Data Architecture & Modeling: Lead database topology decisions across relational engines (SQL) and NoSQL stores (document, key-value, graph, and wide-column), balancing data consistency models, read/write performance, and long-term storage strategies.
Event-Driven Architectures: Architect asynchronous, event-driven platforms utilizing messaging systems and streaming fabrics (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, event brokers) to support decoupled, reactive workflows.
DevOps & Continuous Delivery: Collaborate closely with platform engineering to embed modern CI/CD automation, observability (metrics, logs, traces), automated testing, and secure deployment pipelines across all architectural boundaries.
Internal Developer Platforms (IDP): Drive the architecture and adoption of self-service internal developer platforms that standardize deployment patterns, accelerate developer velocity, and enforce architectural guardrails.
AI Fluency & Emerging Technologies: Pragmatically evaluate and incorporate artificial intelligence, machine learning pipelines, and LLM integrations into core system architectures to modernize capabilities and improve operational efficiency.
Cross-Functional Influence & Alignment: Translate complex business objectives into pragmatic technical roadmaps, aligning engineering teams, product managers, and executive leadership behind unified architectural decisions.
Engineering Mentorship & Talent Growth: Coach and mentor staff engineers, technical leads, and development teams, fostering a strong culture of continuous learning, system-level thinking, and modern software craftsmanship.
Stakeholder Translation & Executive Communication: Distill intricate distributed system concepts, platform constraints, and technology investments into clear, outcome-focused narratives tailored for senior and non-technical executives.
Skills and Minimum Experience Required
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related discipline.
8+ years of software engineering experience with significant architecture responsibility.
Strong experience with enterprise application design.
Experience defining architecture for large-scale business-critical applications.
Strong understanding of distributed systems, integration patterns, event-driven architectures, and microservices concepts.
Experience with Azure, CI/CD, DevOps, security, monitoring, and operational excellence.
Experience working within Agile and SAFe delivery models.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and technical leadership skills.
Preferred Skills and Experience
Proficiency with AI-assisted software development practices.
Experience with Product Data Management (PDM), Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), or Product Information Management platforms.
Experience in commerce, quoting, ordering, manufacturing, supply chain, or digital-product ecosystems.
Experience with event streaming, API management, cloud-native architecture, and modernization programs.
Experience leading architecture reviews, technical strategy, and portfolio-level technology decisions.
Tools & Technologies
Development: Multi-language fluency
Delivery Approach: SAFe, Jira, Confluence, Miro
Cloud & DevOps: Multi-tier cloud environments, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, Observability
Integration: REST APIs, OpenAPI, Event-driven Architecture
Enterprise Platforms: PLM, CPQ, Product Data Systems, CRM

This is an opportunity to work on challenging, high-value projects while developing your project management, technical, commercial and client relationship skills within a collaborative and supportive team.
Purpose & Scope Of The Role
The EIA Specialist will support the successful delivery of environmental assessment projects from inception through to completion. Working as part of Tetra Tech’s Environment, Planning and Renewables division, the role will involve coordinating multi-disciplinary environmental assessment inputs and associated planning documentation, managing project programmes, deliverables, interfaces and competing priorities, and supporting the preparation and delivery of EIA, SEA and related environmental assessment projects. The EIA Specialist will oversee and guide junior team members and sub-consultants, liaise with clients, project teams and relevant stakeholders, and support scope and fee development, budgeting, forecasting and financial control. The role will also ensure that project outputs are technically robust, well coordinated and compliant with relevant Irish and European planning and environmental legislation, while contributing to client relationship development, business growth and the continuous improvement of team processes and deliverables. Working across a varied portfolio of projects and sectors, the successful candidate will collaborate with specialists from across the wider business to deliver practical, high-quality environmental advice.
Your Impact In This Position
In the short term, you will become an integral member of the EIA/SEA Team, providing dependable coordination of project inputs, programmes and deliverables while helping to ensure that project teams remain aligned, deadlines are achieved and clients receive clear, accurate and high-quality outputs. As you develop in the role, you will take increasing ownership of EIA and SEA projects, strengthen your project management and commercial capabilities, and support the development of junior colleagues and sub-consultants. Over the longer term, you will have the opportunity to build trusted relationships with clients and project stakeholders, contribute to winning and growing work in existing and new markets, support the successful delivery of complex environmental assessment projects, develop a strong professional reputation in environmental assessment, contribute to a high-performing, collaborative and technically respected team, and maintain and extend your professional knowledge through continuous professional development.

Familiarity with relevant Irish and European planning and environmental legislation, including the EIA Directive and associated transposing Regulations, is essential. Knowledge of Appropriate Assessment and/or Strategic Environmental Assessment would be advantageous.

The successful candidate will be able to take ownership of projects from inception through to completion and will have experience supporting Project Managers in delivering work to client expectations. They will demonstrate excellent organisational, coordination, verbal communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to work effectively as part of multi-disciplinary project teams. The ability to liaise constructively with clients and relevant stakeholders is essential, as is a client-focused, pragmatic and collaborative approach to project delivery.
Reporting, Documentation & Compliance
The successful candidate will be able to produce and coordinate clear, accurate and timely environmental assessment and planning documentation, supported by strong report-writing and document coordination skills. They will be capable of managing and integrating multiple technical inputs while ensuring that work is delivered in line with internal procedures, relevant legislation and industry standards. Experience supporting quality assurance and maintaining consistency and traceability across project deliverables is also required.

The successful candidate will be able to build and strengthen relationships with existing clients, maintaining a strong focus on client satisfaction and achieving constructive project outcomes. They will have the ability to contribute to scopes of work, fee proposals and tender opportunities, with an interest in supporting the development of new markets and service opportunities. A commitment to maintaining a high level of environmental assessment knowledge and professional awareness is essential, alongside a proactive approach to continuous professional development and business growth.

Experience coordinating planning applications and environmental documentation.
Knowledge of relevant Irish and European planning and environmental legislation.
Demonstrable experience coordinating multi-disciplinary project inputs and deliverables.
Strong written, verbal, organisational and interpersonal communication skills.
Beneficial

jobs.title: Compliance Analyst
jobs.desc:
Location:
Mallow
Contract:
12-18 Month Fixed-Term Contract
The Opportunity
We are seeking a proactive and analytical Wastewater Compliance Analyst to join a growing environmental and utilities team. This is an excellent opportunity for an individual with experience in environmental compliance, water utilities, industrial operations, or a related sector who is passionate about protecting water infrastructure and delivering high standards of environmental performance.
In this role, you will be responsible for supporting compliance activities associated with commercial and industrial wastewater discharges, helping to ensure customers operate in accordance with regulatory requirements and industry standards. You will work closely with a broad range of stakeholders, carrying out site audits, investigations, compliance monitoring and customer engagement activities.
This position offers a varied mix of office-based, field-based and stakeholder-facing responsibilities, making it ideal for someone who enjoys both technical and relationship management aspects of environmental compliance.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct site inspections and compliance audits across commercial and industrial customer locations.
Coordinate and undertake wastewater sampling activities, ensuring procedures and standards are followed.
Review compliance data, identify risks and escalate issues where required.
Build and maintain strong working relationships with customers, contractors and internal stakeholders.
Support investigations into wastewater-related incidents, identifying root causes and recommending corrective actions.
Monitor compliance performance and contribute to KPI reporting and performance improvements.
Accurately record inspection findings, compliance activities and sampling results using company systems.
Support implementation of strategic environmental and compliance initiatives.
Identify businesses requiring wastewater discharge permits through research, site visits and field investigations.
Assist with the development of compliance procedures, standards and best practice guidance.
Promote awareness and education initiatives relating to wastewater management and environmental compliance.
Stay up to date with relevant legislation, industry standards and emerging best practices.
Represent the organisation professionally during customer meetings, investigations and regulatory engagements.
About You
We are interested in hearing from candidates who can demonstrate:
A relevant third-level qualification in Science, Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering or a related discipline (desirable).
Previous experience within water, utilities, environmental compliance, industrial operations or a similar regulated environment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate issues and implement effective solutions.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Experience managing multiple priorities and delivering work within agreed timescales.
Confidence working independently in the field while also contributing effectively within a wider team.
A proactive approach to continuous improvement and process enhancement.
The ability to build productive relationships with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to travel to multiple sites
High levels of professionalism, integrity and attention to detail.
What's on Offer?
The opportunity to work on critical environmental and compliance initiatives.
A varied and challenging role with a mix of site-based and office-based activities.
Exposure to large-scale environmental programmes and strategic projects.
A collaborative and supportive working environment.
The chance to make a tangible impact on environmental performance and sustainable wastewater management.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.desc:
Control Systems Engineer
| Munters Corporation
Join Munters and Help Shape the Future of Data Center Cooling
Munters is a global leader in climate solutions for mission-critical applications. Our Ireland team designs and manufactures advanced cooling technologies that help data centers operate more efficiently, reliably, and sustainably.
We are looking for a
Control Systems Engineer
to join our
Research & Development team
and help develop the next generation of high-efficiency cooling and heat-rejection systems.
This is a hands-on opportunity for an engineer who enjoys combining
software, automation, controls, and real-world equipment
to solve challenging engineering problems.
What You'll Do
Design and develop industrial control strategies using Function Block Diagram (FBD) programming.
Develop and test control software for data center cooling equipment.
Integrate and test controls on prototype systems in the R&D laboratory.
Work with mechanical and electrical engineers to define equipment sequences and operating modes.
Develop and tune PID and cascaded control loops.
Configure sensors, actuators, variable-speed drives, controllers, and automation hardware.
Support testing, data collection, and analysis of control-system performance.
Troubleshoot software, electrical, and system-level control issues.
Maintain software documentation, version control, and revision history.
Support the transition of successful R&D solutions into production.
Contribute to product testing, commissioning, and continuous improvement.
What We're Looking For
Degree in Control Systems Engineering, Mechatronics, Software Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline.
3+ years of experience developing software or controls for industrial systems.
Experience with HVAC, refrigeration, cooling, process control, or industrial automation.
Strong experience with Function Block Diagram programming.
Understanding of control systems, PID tuning, equipment sequencing, and system dynamics.
Experience with industrial sensors, programmable controllers, and automation hardware.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Comfortable working hands-on with prototype equipment.
Strong communication and teamwork skills.
Nice to Have
Experience With
Carel controls
Automated Logic Controls (ALC)
Siemens controllers
BACnet or Modbus
Data center cooling
Refrigeration or thermal management
Prototype development and product validation
Software version control and structured release processes
Why Join Munters?
You'll have the opportunity to work on
innovative cooling technology for the rapidly growing data center industry
, where your work directly impacts energy efficiency, reliability, and sustainability.
You'll also gain exposure to the full product-development lifecycle—from
concept and software development through prototype testing, validation, and production
.
Munters is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives are valued. We encourage qualified candidates to apply, even if you don't meet every listed qualification.

jobs.title: Customer Assistant - Ballincollig Express
jobs.desc:
About the role
We pride ourselves on offering customers the biggest range of products around. And that's not just food, but everything from clothes and kettles to financial services.
But did you know we offer the biggest job opportunities too? With stores across the UK and Ireland, and a variety of roles, we are always looking for people who are as passionate about helping customers as we are.
Our Every Little Helps approach doesn't just apply to our customers. It's at the very heart of everything we do at work - and it's what makes us different. We believe in treating each other with respect, and everyone having the opportunity to get on. That's what makes Tesco such a great place to work.
Should you be successful in your application, your offer will be subject to and conditional upon you providing your bank account details before your agreed start date.
You will be responsible for
Always put the customer first and consider them in everything you do.
Get to know your customers and serve them with pride.
Help to ensure products and services are available for customers at all times.
Handle all products with care to maintain quality and ensure they reach the customer in the best condition.
Keep the shop floor and back areas clean and tidy at all times.
Using the training you receive, follow department routines and processes.
Follow all company policies and adhere to Health and Safety routines.
Whilst you will have a core role, you may be asked to support your colleagues by helping in other departments.
You will need
Able to give great, natural customer service by proactively smiling, greeting, acknowledging and helping customers.
Works hard for customers, your team and your department.
You are able to prioritise to ensure anything you do is right for our customers.
Adaptable and resilient to meet the ever changing demands of our business.
You must be able to follow instructions either verbal or written.
You are reliable and a good timekeeper.
You must be smart and tidy at all times.
Whats in it for you?
We offer excellent benefits that help make Tesco a great place to work. These include but aren't limited to:
Competitive Salary
Bonus Scheme*
Our Virtual GP service provides free and confidential access to an online GP through video GP consultations, and online prescription service for colleagues. The service is also available to families of colleagues who live at the same address for a reduced cost.
24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and family members for in the moment emotional support along with free access to a range of wellbeing services supporting you under our new Wellbeing First approach of Body, Mind and Life.
Colleague Clubcard offering 10% discount across stores and online, with 15% discount weekends once a month (Friday to Sunday), and 20% off twice a year. There is also 20% off F&F clothing, all year long, these various discounts can be extended to a family member with a 2nd Clubcard available.*
Life Assurance
Pension Plan*
Save As You Earn Scheme*
Paid Family Leave
Bike to Work
Long Service Awards
Commuter Scheme
*Entry requirements and rules of the scheme apply
About Us
Our vision at Tesco is to become every customer's favourite way to shop, whether they are at home or out on the move. Our core purpose is "Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day". Serving means more than a transactional relationship with our customers. It means acting as a responsible and sustainable business for all stakeholders, for the communities we are part of, and for the planet. Through initiatives like the Tesco Community Fund, our association with Children's Health Foundation, our partnership with FoodCloud and our Stronger Starts programme, we have supported over 21,000 community groups, raised over €7.5 million for medical equipment, and provided almost 15 million meals nationwide, to those living in food insecurity.
Tesco has operated in the Irish retail market since 1997, and with 190+ stores nationwide, we employ over 13,000 people in cities and towns around Ireland, supporting almost 45,000 jobs directly and indirectly. We partner with over 500 Irish suppliers - of which almost three-quarters are small and medium enterprises - which in turn supports almost 13,000 farming families around Ireland. Tesco is the single largest buyer of Irish food and drink in the world, buying €1.6 Billion a year; more than any other single country in the European Union, more than even the USA which you perceive as a massive buyer of Irish food.
We work closely with suppliers across Ireland who are dedicated to making the best products for our customers and this is reflected in the numerous awards our products have won over the years including Blás Na hÉireann, World Steak Challenge and Great Taste Awards.
We are proud to have an inclusive culture at Tesco where everyone truly feels able to be themselves. It is embedded in our values: we treat people how they want to be treated. At Tesco, we not only celebrate diversity, but recognise the value and opportunity it brings. We always want our colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work and we are committed to helping them be at their best.
We know life looks a little different for each of us. That's why at Tesco, we always welcome chats about flexible working. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life-changing moments like becoming a carer, nearing retirement, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we can support.
Tesco is committed to celebrating diversity and everyone is welcome at Tesco. We're committed to providing a fully inclusive recruitment process, allowing candidates the opportunity to thrive and inform us of any reasonable adjustments they may require. For further information on the accessibility support we can offer, please click http://roi.tesco-careers.com/accessibility/
How can I let Tesco know I need additional support?
Please let us know you need additional support by emailing tescoireland.recruitment@tesco.ie
This will allow us to understand more about you and how we can best support you through the recruitment process.

here
.

Additional Information
JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team
We process applications on an ongoing basis and complete the recruitment until we have found the right candidate.
We always conduct interviews - for selected positions you can also expect to have assessments and/or a video interview, where we look forward to hearing about your motivation for the job.
For more information, please visit our career page.
Learn how we process your data in our Privacy Policy.
To help us review applications fairly and efficiently, we use a system that automatically checks and decides how well each application matches the role.
This system looks at your answers to a few screening questions. These questions were created by the system and reviewed by the JYSK Talent Acquisition team, and each question and answer have a certain value. Based on your answers, the system ranks all candidates to give us an idea of how closely the job fits your profile.
This helps us manage all applications and make sure everyone is treated equally. The result from the system decides if your application moves forward to the next step. But don’t worry — the final decision is always made by a person.
If you’d like to know more about how we process your personal data and your rights, please check our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Night Porter
jobs.desc:
DEPARTMENT/LOCATION
: Front of House
PURPOSE OF JOB:
To ensure that guest queries/needs are quickly and effectively met at night. Ensure that regular security checks and fire checks are carried out each night. To carry out a comprehensive night audit.
RESPONSIBLE TO:
Duty Managers
RESPONSIBLE FOR:
Responsible for the supervision and operations of premises at night.
Duties
MAIN DUTIES:
To arrive for work on time dressed neatly in a full clean uniform, well-groomed, with a name badge and presenting a professional appearance to our guests.
Receive a full handover from the a) Daily Porters b) Receptionists on duty c) Manager on duty
Complete docket checks as appropriate and inform the early Duty Manager of any discrepancies.
Carry out security/fire checks at regular intervals (i.e. 12 am, 2 am, 4 am and 6 am) or as required and log any irregularities in the Handover book, reporting it to the Duty Manager.
To efficiently check-in/out guests during hours of duty and ensure their luggage is brought/collected quickly.
To deal with any guest enquiries/needs quickly and effectively.
To carry out any Lounge/Room Service Orders required after 11 pm to an agreed standard. The kitchen and food preparation areas must be maintained in a clean manner.
To collect Breakfast cards while doing floor checks and prepare and deliver Room Service.
Ensure that any early breakfasts are delivered to the guest on time and to standard.
To cover Bar Service once bar staff has left ensuring correct and diligent cash and stock procedures.
To carry out cleaning as per the night cleaning schedule.
Cleaning of public areas as assigned by management.
Maintenance of Premier Lounge. Stock replenished as required.
Reception desk and office cleaned.
Ensure meeting rooms are refreshed and prepared.
Cleaning of public bathroom areas.
Ensure front areas of the hotel are tidy, cleared of debris and clean.
If necessary, set up meeting rooms to the agreed standard, checking that all equipment is correct and in working order.
To check the fax machine on a regular basis and ensure guests receive any faxes or other messages quickly.
Complete full report of night shift events in diary and handover any problems/incidents to a) Duty Manager b) Receptionist c) Day Porter on duty prior to leaving.
Additional and reasonable duties may be assigned as deemed appropriate by management.

jobs.desc:
Warehouse Controller – Food Manufacturing
Location:
Bantry, Co. Cork
Job Type:
Permanent | Full-Time
Salary:
Competitive, depending on experience + accomodation
The Opportunity
Protea Recruitment is working with an established food manufacturing business in West Cork to recruit a Warehouse Controller for its newly built warehouse facility.
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced warehouse professional to take ownership of daily operations across a frozen cold store (-18°C) and an ambient packaging warehouse.
The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring stock accuracy, efficient material movements and the smooth running of warehouse operations, while maintaining high standards of food safety, quality and health & safety.
Key Responsibilities
Take responsibility for the day-to-day operation of the frozen cold store and ambient packaging warehouse.
Oversee the receipt, checking, storage and movement of raw materials, packaging and finished goods.
Maintain accurate stock records using the company's inventory management system.
Carry out regular stock counts, investigate discrepancies and ensure stock accuracy.
Ensure effective stock rotation using FIFO/FEFO principles.
Coordinate the preparation and movement of materials to production and finished goods for dispatch.
Monitor cold store temperatures and ensure products are maintained under appropriate storage conditions.
Maintain high standards of warehouse housekeeping, cleanliness and organisation.
Ensure compliance with HACCP, food safety, hygiene and health & safety standards.
Safely operate forklifts and associated warehouse equipment.
Work closely with Production, Purchasing, Quality and Logistics teams to support operational requirements.
Support internal and external audits, maintaining accurate warehouse records and documentation.
Identify opportunities to improve warehouse processes, efficiency and stock control.
What We're Looking For
Essential:
Previous experience in warehouse operations, stock control or inventory management.
A valid forklift licence.
Strong understanding of stock management, stock rotation and inventory accuracy.
Confident IT skills, including experience using warehouse or stock management systems.
Ability to work independently, prioritise tasks and take ownership of daily operations.
Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
A strong commitment to workplace safety and operational standards.
Desirable:
Experience within food manufacturing, chilled/frozen food distribution or FMCG.
Previous experience working in cold store environments.
Knowledge of HACCP and food safety standards.
Experience supporting warehouse audits and compliance procedures.
Experience helping to establish or improve warehouse systems and processes.
What's on Offer?
Permanent opportunity with an established food manufacturing business.
Opportunity to take ownership of a newly built warehouse facility.
A varied, hands-on role combining warehouse operations and stock control.
The chance to contribute to operational improvements and warehouse efficiency.
Competitive salary dependent on experience and accomodation.

jobs.title: Cork Cabin Crew Opportunities (Dubai Based, Relocation Provided)
jobs.desc:
Job Purpose
A personality that shines, the ability to adapt to any situation and make people feel at ease. These are a few of the qualities we’re looking for in our cabin crew.
As the face of Emirates, you’ll be the person customers turn to for help and direction when they fly with us, so you need to be friendly, observant and able to provide the right support.
Being a member of the cabin crew is so much more than a service role - safety is our highest priority. You’ll need to lead confidently and take control when it comes to managing aircraft services, security, and safety procedures. This comes from the world-class learning experience our crew receive at our state-of-the-art facility in Dubai.
Qualifications & Experience
Here are some other things we look for in our cabin crew:
You’ve had more than a year’s experience in hospitality/customer service
You have a positive attitude and the natural ability to provide excellent service in a team environment, dealing with people from many cultures
Your minimum qualification is high school graduate (Grade 12)
You need to be fluent in written and spoken English
You’re at least 160cm tall and can reach 212 cm while standing on tiptoes, to enable you to reach emergency equipment on all aircraft types
No visible tattoos while you’re in Emirates cabin crew uniform (without covering them with bandages or cosmetics)
As Emirates cabin crew, you’ll be based in Dubai and will need to meet the UAE's employment visa requirements
Aside from the requirements of the role, you should be determined to always perform to the highest standards, focus on being solution oriented, and be able to manage a demanding work schedule. You should have the ability to deliver an authentic experience to our customers. You’ll be culturally aware and reflect the Emirates personality - professional, empathetic, progressive, visionary and cosmopolitan.
Salary & Benefits
Your pay is made up of three components:
a fixed basic salary,
an hourly pay for operated flights and
an overseas meal allowance.
Basic salary = AED 4,980 / month,
Flying Pay = AED 69.60 / hour based on avg. 80-100 hours / month,
Average Total Pay = AED 11,244 / month (~USD 3,100, EUR 2,600 or GBP 2,280)
* These are approximate numbers for Grade II (Economy Class).
Meal allowances for night stops are credited to the salary in arrears the following month.
Hotel accommodation as well as transport to and from the airport is provided by the company.
Join Emirates as cabin crew and enjoy a competitive, tax-free salary, flying pay, profit share, and concessional travel. Benefit from comprehensive relocation support to help you settle in Dubai, along with free accommodation and transportation. You will also receive excellent medical, life, and dental insurance, and more. Additionally, your friends and family can enjoy discounted flights, creating lasting memories together.
